༄༅// dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sidhaṃ rastu/ dam pa'i chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ gsung gi dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sa yi dbang phyug mi pham thogs med dang*// mkhyen rab dbang phyug dbyig gnyen blo brtan sogs// skad gnyis dbang phyug rnams la gus btud nas// dam chos mngon pa'i mtshan nyid rab gsal bya// 'dir bshad par bya ba ni chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ de la bod kyi slob dpon rnams kyis mtshan nyid ces pa rnams de min las 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid kho nar 'chad pa ni cung zad ma dgongs pa ste/ mdo dang dgongs 'grel rnams su rang gi mtshan nyid dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ces pa gnyis dang*/ yang rang gi mtshan nyid dang rnam par dbye ba'i mtshan nyid ces pa gnyis dang*/ yang rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshan nyid dang de min gcod pa'i mtshan nyid ces pa gnyis dang*/ bsdu bar rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ gnas dang gnas par 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ nye bar spyod pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ byed las kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ cha phra ba'i mtshan nyid ces pa drug gsungs pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid sna tshogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum du btags te de'i spros pas mtshon sbyor zhes bya ba/ nyan pa po rnams mgo rmongs pa bskyed cing dka' la don chung ba mdzad pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mtshon bya dang mtshan gzhi rgya skad gcig la lo tsā ba'i 'gyur tha dad tsam gyis chos tha dad ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhung chen po rnams su rtags kyi sbyor ba zhes pa nyid kyi/ de las khyad par gyur pa'i mtshon sbyor zhes pa ni cung zad kyang ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang mtshan mtshon grangs mnyam par gsungs pa'ang ma nges te/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis tshad ma dang bsgrub bya la mtshan nyid gnyis gnyis gsungs pa sogs chos re re la'ang gzhung lugs rnams su mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba du ma bshad pa mthong ba'i phyir ro// des na mtshan nyid ni/

rang gi mtshon bya ji ltar rigs pas thun mong dang thun mong min par mtshon par byed pa yin zhing*/ mtshon bya dang mtshon byed gnyis nyid du gnas so// de lta na'ang 'dir ni don du gnyer ba rnams 'jug pa bde bar bya ba'i phyir gtso cher de min gcod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi dbang du byas te brjod par bya'o// de la 'dir skabs su bab pa chos mngon pa yin pas/ chos mngon pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ste/ mdzod kyi 'grel bshad rgyal po'i sras su/ 'dir yang chos mngon pa ni shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa yin no// zhes so// de la gnyis las/ dang po don dam pa'i mngon pa'i mtshan nyid/ zag pa med pa'i shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ste/ mdzod rtsa 'grel du/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas// zhes dang*/ de lta na/ zag pa med pa'i phung po lnga la chos mngon pa zhes bstan par 'gyur ro// 'di ni re zhig don dam pa'i chos mngon pa'o// zhes so// gnyis pa brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa'i mtshan nyid/ zag med kyi shes rab thob byed kyi thabs zag bcas kyi shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'am/ gzhung gi tshogs ci rigs pa/ de la dbye na/ lam mngon pa dang gzhung mngon pa gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ zag med kyi shes rab thob byed kyi thabs zag bcas kyi shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ lhag pa'i shes rab thun mong ma yin pa'i brjod byar ston pa'i gzhung gi tshogs te/ mdzod rtsa 'grel du/ brdar btags pa ni/ de thob bya phyir gang dang bstan bcos gang*// zhes so// gzhung mngon pa'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i kun las btus pa 'di le'u lnga'i bdag nyid du gnas pa las thog mar le'u dang po mtshan nyid kun las btus pas gtan la dbab par bya ba'i chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid la/ phung po'i mtshan nyid/ du ma spungs pa/ dbye na lnga ste/ gzugs/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/

'du byed/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o// gzugs kyi phung po'i mtshan nyid/ reg pa'am yul dpyad pas gzugs su rung ba gang zhig du ma spungs pa ste/ gzugs rung dang po ni/ gzugs can nang phrad pas 'gyur ba bskyed du rung ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ gang bems po'i dngos por grub par snang ba/ tshor ba'i phung po'i mtshan nyid/ sim gdung bar ma gang rung gi ngo bor myong ba'i sems byung gang zhig du ma spungs pa/ 'du shes kyi phung po'i mtshan nyid/ yul gyi spu ris 'byed pa'i sems byung gang zhig du ma spungs pa/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs tshor ba 'du shes rnam shes bzhi po gang yang min pa'i 'dus byas gang zhig du ma spungs pa/ rnam shes phung po'i mtshan nyid/ yul gyi ngo bo tsam rig pa'i blo gang zhig du ma spungs pa/ khams kyi mtshan nyid/ nyer spyod 'dzin pa mngon 'gyur dang sa bon ci rigs pa/ dbye na bco brgyad de/ mig gi khams nas yid kyi rnam shes kyi khams kyi bar ro// mig gi khams kyi mtshan nyid mig shes kyi gnas byas pas nyer spyod 'dzin pa mngon gyur dang sa bon ci rigs pa/ rna ba'i khams sogs lnga la'ang ji ltar mthun mthun du sbyar ro// gzugs kyi khams kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyi dmigs pa byas pas nyer spyod 'dzin pa/ sgra'i khams sogs lnga la'ang ji ltar mthun mthun du sbyar ro// mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen mig gi dbang po la brten nas gzugs kyi ngo bo tsam rig cing nyer spyod 'dzin pa mngon gyur dang sa bon ci rigs pa/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams sogs lnga la'ang ji ltar mthun mthun du sbyar ro// skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ nyer spyod skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa/ dbye na bcu gnyis te/ mig gi skye mched nas chos kyi skye mched kyi bar ro// mig gi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyi gnas byas pas nyer spyod skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa/

mngon gyur dang sa bon ci rigs pa/ rna ba'i skye mched sogs lnga la'ang ji ltar mthun mthun du sbyar ro// gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyis dmigs pa byas pa'i nyer spyod skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa/ sgra'i skye mched sogs lnga la'ang ji ltar mthun mthun du sbyar ro// gzugs kyi phung po la dbye na gnyis te/ rgyu'i gzugs dang*/ 'bras bu'i gzugs so// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes kyis gzung ba gang zhig 'byung 'gyur min pa/ dbye na bzhi ste/ sa'i khams dang*/ chu'i dang*/ me'i dang*/ rlung gi khams so// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes la sra bar snang ba'i reg bya/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes la gsher bar snang ba'i reg bya/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes la dro bar snang ba'i reg bya/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes la yang zhing g.yo bar snang ba'i reg bya/ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu 'byung ba chen po las skyes pa'i gzugs gang zhig 'byung ba min pa/ dbye na gsum ste/ dang ba'i gzugs dang*/ dang bas gzung ba'i gzugs dang*/ yid kyi yul gyi gzugs so// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ nang gi skye mched gzugs can dang ba/ dbye na lnga ste/ mig gi dbang po dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus kyi dbang po'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyi bdag rkyen gzugs can dang ba/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyan shes kyi bdag rkyen gzugs can dang ba/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ sna'i rnam shes kyi bdag rkyen gzugs can dang ba/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ lce'i rnam shes kyi bdag rkyen gzugs can dang ba/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes kyi bdag rkyen gzugs can dang ba'o// gnyis pa dang bas gzung ba'i gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbang shes kyi gzung ba/ dbye na lnga ste/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya'i phyogs gcig go

/gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyi gzung bya/ dbye na/ kha dog dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ rnam par rig byed de gsum mo// rgyas par dbye na sngon po sogs nyer lnga'o// sgra'i mtshan nyid/ mnyan bya/ dbye na/ yid du 'ong ba'i sgra sogs bcu gcig go /dri'i mtshan nyid/ sna'i rnam shes kyi gzung bya/ dbye na dri zhim po sogs drug go /ro'i mtshan nyid/ lce'i rnam shes kyi gzung bya/ dbye na kha skyur sogs bcu gnyis so// reg bya'i phyogs gcig gi mtshan nyid/ lus kyi rnam shes kyi gzung bya'i 'byung 'gyur/ dbye na 'jam pa sogs nyer gnyis so// yang 'byung ba la rgyu'i reg bya dang 'di la 'bras bu yi reg bya zhes dang*/ 'bras bu yi gzugs la 'byung 'gyur gyi gzugs zhes kyang brjod do// gsum pa yid kyi yul gyi gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ yid shes kyi yul chos kyi skye mched gzugs su bzhag pa/ dbye na bsdus pa las gyur pa sogs lnga'o// tshor ba'i phung po la ngo bos dbye na lnga ste/ bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ yid bde dang*/ yid mi bde dang*/ btang snyoms so// bde ba'i mtshan nyid/ sim pa'i tshor ba gang zhig yid bde ma yin pa/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ dbang shes kyi 'khor du skyes pa'i tshor ba gang zhig sim pa min pa/ yid bde'i mtshan nyid/ sim pa'i tshor ba gang zhig bde ba min pa/ yid mi bde ba'i mtshan nyid/ yid shes kyi 'khor du skyes pa'i tshor ba sim pa min pa/ btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid/ sim gdung gnyis ka spangs pa'i tshor ba'o// yang rten gyis dbye na/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad la brten pa'i brgyad dang*/ gnas kyis dbye na/ lus tshor dang*/ sems tshor gnyis dang*/ spong gnyen gyis dbye na/ zang zing dang bcas pa dang*/ zang zing med pa gnyis dang*/ zhen pa brten pa dang mngon par 'byung ba brten pa gnyis kyi tshor bar dbye'o// 'du shes kyi phung po la gnas kyis dbye na/ rnam shes tshogs drug gam brgyad/

'du byed kyi phung po la dbye na/ sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i 'du byed dang*/ mtshungs par mi ldan pa'i 'du byed do// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ tshor 'du min zhing*/ rang gi gtso bo sems dang mtshungs ldan lngas mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems 'byung*/ dbye na/ sde tshan drug ste/ kun 'gro dang*/ yul nges dang*/ dge ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ gzhan 'gyur ro// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rigs can sems kun dang nges par mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na/ spyir lnga las tshor 'du gnyis ni phung po la sogs pa yin zhing mtshan nyid brjod zin la/ lhag ma gsum ste/ sems pa dang*/ yid la byed pa dang*/ reg pa'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sems mngon par 'du byed pa yid kyi las/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa la sems skad cig re rer gtod pa'i sems byung*/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gsum 'dus nas dbang po'i 'gyur ba dang 'dra ba'i yul gcod pa'i sems byung ngo*// sde tshan gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba dang nyon mongs gang yang min zhing yul so so la mtha' gcig tu nges par 'jug pa'i sems byung rdzas yod/ dbye na lnga ste/ 'dun pa dang*/ mos pa dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab bo// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod bya'i yul don du gnyer ba'i sems 'byung*/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ nges pa'i yul la nges pa bzhin du 'dzin pa'i sems byung*/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi dmigs pa mi brjed pa'i sems byung rdzas yod/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa'i sems byung*/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi sems byung ngo*// gsum pa dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ chos gzhan la mi ltos par rang rgyu las dge ba'i ngo bor skyes pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na bcu gcig ste/ dad pa dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ khrel yod pa dang*/ ma chags pa'i dge ba dang*/

zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba dang*/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ bag yod pa dang*/ 'du byed btang snyoms dang*/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i dge ba'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ ma dad pa'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na gsum mo// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa'i sems byung*/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa'i sems byung*/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ chags pa'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i sems byung*/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ zhe sdang gi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i sems byung*/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ gti mug gi dngos gnyen gang zhig shes rab kyi cha la btags pa/ bdun pa'i mtshan nyid/ dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung*/ brgyad pa'i mtshan nyid/ lus sems las su rung ba/ dgu pa'i mtshan nyid/ blang dor la gzob pa lhur len pa'i sems byung*/ bcu pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs kyi cha mi snyoms pa med pas btang snyoms su gyur pa'i sems byung*/ bcu gcig pa'i mtshan nyid/ snying rje'i sems tho mi 'tsham pa'i sems byung btags yod/ bzhi pa nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i sems byung gang zhig srid pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa/ dbye na drug ste/ 'dod chags dang*/ khong khro dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ nyon mongs ba can gyi ma rig pa dang*/ the tshom dang*/ lta ba'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ lus sam longs spyod la chags pa'i sems byung*/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnod byed la kun nas mnar sems pa'i sems byung rdzas yod/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'jig lta la brten nas sems khengs pa'i sems byung*/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi la rmongs pa'i sems byung*/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi la yid gnyis za ba'i sems byung*/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ rtog pa'i bdag nyid kyi shes rab nyon mongs su gyur pa/

dbye na lnga ste/ 'jig lta dang*/ mthar 'dzin lta ba dang*/ lta ba mchog 'dzin dang*/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin dang*/ log lta'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ phung po la bdag gam bdag gir 'dzin pa'i sems byung*/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ phung po la rtag pa'am chad par 'dzin pa'i sems byung*/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ dman pa la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i sems byung*/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dag grol min pa la 'dag grol du 'dzin pa'i sems byung*/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu 'bras la skur pa 'debs pa'am sgro 'dogs pa'i sems byung gang zhig 'jig lta sogs gzhan bzhi min pa'o// lnga pa nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid/ sems nyon mongs pa dang nye bar byed cing rtsa nyon min pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na nyi shu las/ khro ba'i mtshan nyid/ da ltar gyi gnod byed kho na la kun nas mnar sems pa'i sems byung btags yod/ khon du 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid/ sngar gyi gnod byed kho na la gnod lan byed 'dod pa'i sems byung btags yod/ 'chab pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyes pa gsal por sbed pa'i sems byung*/ 'tshig pa'i mtshan nyid/ khro ba dang khon 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba'i sems byung gang zhig tshig rtsub kun nas slong byed/ phrag dog gi mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi phun tshogs mi bzod pa'i sems byung*/ ser sna'i mtshan nyid/ yo byad la sems 'chum pa'i sems byung*/ sgyu'i mtshan nyid/ yon tan dang mi ldan yang ldan pa ltar du ston pa'i sems byung*/ g.yo'i mtshan nyid/ nyes pa zur gyis sbed pa'i sems byung*/ rgyags pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi chos la ma ltos par rang gi chos la chags pas sems gang ba'i sems byung*/ rnam par 'tshe ba'i mtshan nyid/ snying rje med pas gzhan la tho 'tsham pa'i sems byung*/ ngo tsha med pa'i nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa'i sems byung*/ khrel med pa'i nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa'i sems byung*/

rmugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ lus sems ltar bar byed pa'i sems byung*/ blo brtan dang ye shes bshes gnyen ltar na/ sems blun par gyur nas dge ba'i dmigs pa la mi gsal bar byed pa'i sems byung ngo*// rgod pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod chags kho na'i char gtogs shing sems ma zhi bar 'phro ba'i sems byung*/ ma dad pa'i mtshan nyid/ dad pa'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i sems byung*/ le lo'i mtshan nyid/ dge ba la mi spro ba'i sems 'byung*/ bag med pa'i nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid/ blor phyin ci log tu sgrub pa'i sems byung*/ brjed ngas kyi mtshan nyid/ dge ba'i dmigs pa brjed pa'i nyon mongs can gyin dran pa/ shes bzhin min pa'i nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa la mi shes bzhin du 'jug pa'i nyon mongs can gyi shes rab/ rnam g.yeng gi mtshan nyid/ sems kyi rnam par 'phro ba/ rnam g.yeng nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid/ dug gsum char ji ltar srid pa la btags pa'i sems kyi rnam par 'phro ba'i sems byung ngo*// drug pa gzhan 'gyur gyi mtshan nyid/ dge sogs gsum po gang du'ang 'gyur du rung ba'i sems byung btags yod/ dbye na bzhi las/ gnyid kyi mtshan nyid/ 'jug pa rang dbang med par sems sdud pa'i sems byung*/ 'gyod pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems kyi yid la gcag pa'i sems byung*/ rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshol ba'i rnam pa can sems rtsing ba/ dpyod pa'i mtshan nyid/ so sor rtog pa'i rnam pa can sems zhib pa'o// gnyis pa ldan min 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus byas kyi bye brag gang zhig gzugs sems sems byung gsum po gang yang min pa/ dbye na nyer gsum ste/ thob pa nas tshogs pa'i bar ro// thob pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos rnams kyi 'phel 'grib kyi cha/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ so skye'i rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig tshogs drug 'khor bcas 'gag pa'i cha/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/

'phags pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig tshogs bdun 'khor bcas 'gag pa'i cha/ 'du shes med pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gang zhig phal cher tshogs drug 'khor dang bcas pa 'gag pa'i cha/ srog gi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ tshe gcig gi phung po'i rgyun sngon gyi 'phen pas gnas pa'i dus nges pa'i cha/ ris mthun pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems can gyi phung po 'dra ba'i cha/ nang gi 'du byed kyi zhes bzhi'i bar la sbyar te/ skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ sems can gyi tshe gcig gi phung po'i rgyun sngon ma byung ba las byung ba'i cha/ rga ba'i mtshan nyid/ sems can gyi tshe gcig gi phung po rgyun gzhan du 'gyur ba'i cha/ gnas pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems can gyi tshe gcig gi phung po'i rgyun mi 'jig pa'i cha/ mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems can gyi tshe gcig gi phung po'i rgyun 'jig pa'i cha/ ming gi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i tshig bla dwags/ tshig gi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig bla dwags/ yi ge'i tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ don mi ston pa'i sgra spyir snang ba/ so so skye bo'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags par 'jog byed kyi chos ma thob pa'i gang zag 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rgyun mi chad pa'i cha/ so sor nges pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu tha dad kyi rgyu yang tha dad pa'i cha/ 'byor 'brel pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu de dang de'i 'bras bur de dang des 'os pa'i cha/ mgyogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dus byas myur bar 'ong ba'i cha/ go rim gyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus byas rim can du 'byung ba'i cha/ dus kyi mtshan nyid/ rgyu 'bras bu gnyis ka spyad zin pa'am gnyis ka spyad ma zin pa'am/ rgyu spyad la 'bras bu ma spyad pa'i cha/ yul gyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs kyi rgyu 'bras phyogs la khyab pa'i cha/ grangs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'du byed rnams kyi so so tha dad pa'i cha/ tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid/

rgyu rkyen 'dus pa'i cha'o// rnam shes phung po la dbye na/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad de/ kun gzhi dang*/ nyon yid dang*/ mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus dang*/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rnam smin sa bon thams cad ji ltar rigs par brten pa don gyi ngo bo rig pa'i blo ces pa'am/ bag chags bsgor rung gi rnam shes ces pa'am/ yang na 'khor 'das kyi rten gang zhig don gyi ngo bo rig pa'i blo'o// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ kun gzhi'i don tsam rig cing rab tu ma zhi ba'i rnam pas 'jug pa/ yang na kun gzhi'i ngo bo tsam rig cing 'phags pa'i lam ma thob kyi bar du rtag tu ngar 'jug rlom pa'i rnam pas 'jug pa'i blo/ gsum pa mig shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen mig dbang la brten cing gzugs kyi ngo bo tsam rig pa'i blo/ rna ba sogs lnga la'ang ci ltar mthun mthun du sbyar ro// phung pos ma bsdus pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid/ chos gang rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa/ dbye na drug ste/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ so sor brtag min gyi 'gog pa dang*/ so sor brtag 'gog dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i 'gog pa dang*/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bdag gis stong pa'i dbyings gang zhig gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ zag med tsam kho nas phye ba'i 'dus ma byas/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyen pos ma spangs kyang rgyu rkyen ma tshang ba'i stobs kyis gtan ma skyes pa'i 'gog pa/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyen pos spangs bya spangs pas ma skyes pa'i 'gog pa/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'gyur ba bskyed pa'i tshor ba kun spangs pas phye ba'i med 'gag drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshor 'du rags pa kun 'gag pas phye ba'i med dgag go /rnam pa'i dbye ba la rdzas yod kyi mtshan nyid/ brjod pa dang*/ de las gzhan pa la mi ltos par dbang po'i spyod yul du 'gyur ba/

btags yod kyi mtshan nyid/ dbang po'i spyod yul du 'gyur ba brjod pa dang de las gzhan pa la ltos pa/ kun rdzob tu yod pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang la dmigs pas kun nas nyon mongs pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba/ dam pa'i don gyi mtshan nyid/ gang la dmigs pas dri ma rnam par dag par 'gyur ba/ shes bya yi mtshan nyid/ blo'i yul du byar rung ba/ dbye na shes bya yi gzhi lnga'o// rnam par shes bya yi mtshan nyid/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad gang rung gi yul du gyur pa/ mngon par shes bya'i mtshan nyid/ mngon shes gang rung gi yul du gyur pa/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ rten dang brten pa'i gzugs ci rigs pa yod pa'am gzugs can du 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa gang rung yin pa/ gzugs can min pa'i mtshan nyid/ rten dang brten pa'i gzugs med pa'am/ gzugs can min par 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa gang rung yin pa/ bstan yod kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyi yul du rung ba'am bstan yod du 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa gang rung yin pa/ bstan med kyi mtshan nyid/ mig shes kyi yul du mi rung ba'am bstan med du 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa gang rung yin la/ thogs bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi yul du gzugs gzhan nam gzugs gzhan yod par rang 'byung ba'i go 'gegs pa'am thog bcas su 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa gang rung yin pa/ thogs med kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi yul du gzugs gzhan nam gzugs gzhan yod par rang 'byung ba'i go mi 'gegs pa'am thogs med du 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa gang rung yin pa/ zag bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa dang sgo drug gang rung gis 'brel pa/ zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa dang sgo drug gang gis kyang ma 'brel ba/ 'thab bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'thab rgyu dug gsum dang sgo drug gang rung gis 'brel ba/ 'thab med kyi mtshan nyid/ 'thab rgyu dug gsum dang sgo drug gang gis kyang ma 'brel ba/

zang zing dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid/ yang srid kyi rgyu dug gsum dang sgo drug gang rung gis 'brel ba/ zang zing med pa'i mtshan nyid/ yang srid kyi rgyu dug gsum dang sgo drug gang gis kyang ma 'brel ba/ zhen pa brten pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod yon la zhen pa'i rgyu dug gsum dang sgo drug gang rung gis 'brel ba/ mngon par 'byung ba brten pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod yon la zhen pa'i rgyu dug gsum dang sgo drug gang gis kyang ma 'brel ba/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid/ skye 'jig tu snang ba/ 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid/ skye 'jig mi snang ba'i chos/ 'jig rten pa'i mtshan nyid/ khams gsum par snang ba/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ khams gsum par mi snang ba'i chos/ byung ba'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen las skyes zin pa/ ma byung ba'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen las skyes ma zin pa/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid/ yul la longs spyod byed/ gzung ba'i mtshan nyid/ yul can gyi longs spyod bya/ phyi ltas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod yon la sred pa 'phel ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos/ nang ltas kyi mtshan nyid/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos/ nyon mongs can gyi mtshan nyid/ mi dge ba'am sgrib la lung ma bstan gang rung yin pa/ sgrib la lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs can gang zhig mi dge ba yin mi srid pa/ nyon mongs can min pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid/ dge ba'am ma bsgrib la lung ma bstan gang rung yin pa/ ma bsgrib lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs can min pa'i chos gang zhig dge ba min pa/ 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ byung ba la 'gags pa'i dus/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu yod kyang ma byung ba'i dus/ da lta ba'i mtshan nyid/ byung la ma 'gags pa'i dus/ dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig dam pa rnams kyis blang byar 'os pa/ dbye na bcu gsum gyi/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dkar ba'i ngo bor skyes pa/

'brel pas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ grogs stobs kyis rnam par dkar ba'i ngo bor skyes pa/ rjes su 'brel pas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ dge bas bzhag pa'i nus pa/ slong bas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ dge bas kun nas bslang ba'i lus sam ngag gi legs spyad kyi las/ don dam pa'i dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi ngor gcig tu kha na ma tho ba med pa/ skye bas thob pa'i dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ sngon goms pa'i stobs kyis tshe 'dir ris mthun bzung ba tsam gyis kun tu spyod pa'i dkar chos/ sbyor bas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ tshe 'dir 'bad pa'i stobs kyis kun tu spyod pa'i dkar chos/ mdun du byas pa'i dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ yon tan can la mchod par 'dod pas kun tu spyod pa'i dkar chos/ phan 'dogs pas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ dman pa la phan par 'dod pas kun tu spyod pa'i dkar chos/ yongs su 'dzin pas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu 'dod pa 'dzin pa'i dkar chos/ gnyen pos dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa'i dkar chos/ nye bar zhi ba'i dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ sgrib pa zhi ba'i dkar chos/ rgyu mthun pas dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ sgrib pa zhi ba'i dbang gis thob pa'i yon tan/ mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig dam pa rnams kyi dor byar 'os pa/ dbye na bcu gnyis kyi/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin gyis nyes spyod kun nas slong byed du skyes pa/ 'brel bas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ grogs stobs kyis nyes spyod kun nas slong byed du skyes pa'i sdig pa/ rjes su 'brel bas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi dge bas bzhag pa'i nus pa/ slong bas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi dge bas kun nas bslang ba'i lus sam ngag gi nyes spyod kyi las/ don dam pa'i mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pas gcig tu kha na ma tho ba dang bcas par gzigs pa/ skye bas thob pa'i mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/

sngon goms pa'i stobs kyis tshe 'dir ris mthun bzung ba tsam gyis kun tu spyod pa'i nyes spyod/ sbyor bas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ tshe 'dir 'bad pa'i stobs kyis kun tu spyod pa'i nyes spyod/ mdun du byas pa'i mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ lha mchod pa'i bsam pas kun tu spyod pa'i nyes spyod/ gnod pa byed pas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan la log par bsgrub pa'i nyes spyod/ yongs su 'dzin pas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu mi 'dod pa 'dzin pa'i nyes spyod/ mi mthun phyogs kyi mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyen po'i bar du gcod pa'i chos/ bar du gcod pas mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ dge ba'i bar chad byed pa'i chos/ lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ dge mi dge gang du'ang ma grub cing dam pa rnams kyis btang snyoms su bya bar 'os pa'i chos/ dbye na bcu bzhi'i/ ngo bo nyid kyis lung du ma bstan pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin gyis dge mi dge gang du'ang ma grub pa'i chos/ 'brel bas lung du ma bstan pa'i mtshan nyid/ grogs stobs kyis lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i chos/ rjes su 'brel bas lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ lung ma bstan gyis bzhag pa'i nus pa/ slong bas lung du ma bstan pa'i mtshan nyid/ lung ma bstan gyi sems kyis bslang ba'i lus sam ngag gi las/ don dam par lung du ma bstan pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs kyis kyang dge mi dge gang du'ang bzhag par mi nus pa'i 'dus ma byas/ skye bas thob pa'i lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ mi dge ba'am dge ba zag bcas kyi rnam smin yin pa/ sbyor bas lung du ma bstan pa'i mtshan nyid/ lung ma bstan gyi sems dang ldan pa'i 'phral gyi kun spyod/ mdun du bya bas lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ lha mchod pa'i bsam pas kun tu spyod pa'i lung ma bstan gyi las/ phan 'dogs pas lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan la zas gos sogs kyis sbyin pa'i lung ma bstan gyi las/

nye bar spyad pas lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ rang nyid zas gos sogs spyod pa'i lung ma bstan gyi las/ yongs su 'dzin pas lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba la rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yongs su 'dzin par nus pa'i lung ma bstan gyi las/ gnyen pos lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ lung ma bstan gyi sems kyis nad kyi gnyen por sman bsten pa'i las/ nye bar zhi ba'i lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ nyes spyod kun nas slong ba'i nus pa ting nge 'dzin gyis nyams par byas pa'i nyon mongs/ rgyu mthun pas lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ lung ma bstan gyi sprul sems dang lhan cig skyes pa'i las/ 'dod khams kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa la ye 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i chos/ gzugs khams kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral la/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i dge ba zag bcas sam lung ma bstan/ gzugs med khams kyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral la gzugs med la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i dge ba zag bcas sam lung ma bstan yin pa/ slob pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid/ thar pa'i ched du dge ba la brtson par byed pa'i dge ba/ mi slob pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid/ bslab pa gsum mthar phyin pa'i dge ba/ slob mi slob gnyis min gyi chos kyi mtshan nyid/ thar pa rgyu 'bras gang gis kyang ma bsdus pa'i chos/ mthong spang gi mtshan nyid/ bden pa'i chos nyid mthong ba tsam gyis gzhom bya/ sgom spang gi mtshan nyid/ chos nyid mthong zin goms pas gzhom bya/ spang bya min pa'i mtshan nyid/ skyon med pas sun dbyung bya min pa/ rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen du 'os pa las skyes pa/ dbye na gnyis kyi/ zag med rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig zag pa'i sgo drug gang dang yang ma 'brel ba/ zag bcas rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel ba/ de la gnyis kyi/

nyon mongs can gyi phyi'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ sems kyi rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas rkyen las skyes pa/ nyon mongs can gyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid/ sems kyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas rkyen las skyes pa/ de la dbye na bcu gnyis kyi/ ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ yang srid kyi rgyu'i las kun nas slong nus kyi nyon mongs gang zhig rig pa ye shes kyi dngos kyi mi mthun phyogs/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid/ yang srid 'phen byed kyi las/ rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ 'du byed kyi bzhag pa'i las kyi bag chags can gyi sems/ ming gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ las kyi bag chags can gyi rnam shes mngal du zhugs pas grub pa'i phung po/ skye mched drug gi mtshan nyid/ ming gzugs 'phel bas mig sogs drug tshang ba'i nang gi dbang po/ rig pa dang tshor ba sngar bzhin no// sred pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshor ba blang dor du chags pa'i 'dod chags/ len pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod lha sogs bzhi la 'dun cing chags pa'i 'dod chags/ yang na las kyi bag chags brtas par byed pas 'gro ba bye brag tu nges byed kyi chags pa/ srid pa'i mtshan nyid/ las kyi sa bon nus pa mthu can skye ba bskyed nges su gyur pa/ skye sogs kyi sngar bzhin no// rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu bskyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa/ dbye na/ rkyen bzhi'i rgyu rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu yi ngo bo skyed byed/ dbye na don dam pa dang tha snyad pa'i rgyu rkyen gnyis kyi/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ yang dag par 'bras bu'i ngo bo skyed byed/ dbye na zag bcas dang zag med 'dus byas kyi rgyu rkyen gnyis so// tha snyad pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ kun rdzob tu 'bras bu bskyed pa'i thabs su bzhag tu rung ba/ dbye na drug gi byed rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu la phan 'dog byed/ dbye na 'byung ba'i byed rgyu sogs nyi shu'o// lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu'i mtshan nyid/

tshogs pa gcig pa'i stobs kyis rang dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i grogs la phan 'dog byed/ mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ rang dang lhan cig pa'i shes rig gi dmigs pa mthun par rtogs pa'i grogs byed pa/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ rang dang ris mthun pa nyid kyi 'bras bu skyed byed/ kun 'gro'i rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs can gang zhig rang dang ris mthun mi mthun gyi nyon mongs can skyed byed du gyur pa/ rnam smin gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'am mi 'dod pa'i rnam smin 'phen byed/ de ma thag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ rang 'gags stobs kyis rang dang mthun pa'i shes pa phyi ma skye ba'i go 'byed pa/ dmigs rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas shes pa skyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa/ bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ dbang byed pa'i sgo nas 'bras bu skyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa/ yang nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis kyi/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu'i khyad par skyed byed/ bsten mtshungs kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gis bsten pa'i dbang shes dang yul 'dzin byed du 'dra ba'i dbang po gzugs can/ de mtshungs kyi dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ rnam shes bsten bzhin pa dang bral bas yul dngos su mi 'dzin cing dbang po gzugs can rang gi rigs dang 'dra ba/ zin pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshor ba 'byung ba'i gnas kyi gzugs/ dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang la lhag par dbang byed pa'i chos/ dbye na nyer gnyis so// sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gnas dang bcas pas bsdus pa'i chos/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba gnas dang bcas pas bsdus pa'i chos/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba btang snyoms gnas dang bcas pas bsdus pa'i chos/ rnam smin dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid/

rnam smin gyi rgyu ltar ro// rnam smin gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam smin gyi rgyus 'phangs pa'i sgo nas rnam smin du 'jog pa'i chos dang ldan pa/ zas kyi mtshan nyid/ srid pa gso zhing gnas par byed pa'i chos/ dbye na khams kyi dang*/ reg pa'i dang*/ sems pa'i dang*/ rnam shes kyi zas te bzhi'o// gong ma dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid/ bla ma dang bcas pa/ gong na med pa'i mtshan nyid/ bla na med pa/ kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ rdzas su med bzhin du rtogs pas sgro btags pa'i cha/ gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ bdag tu rtog pa'i 'khrul gzhi rkyen la rag las pa/ 'gyur med yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag gis stong pa'i dbyings/ rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do// mtshan nyid kyis dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ ngo bo'i dbye ba/ rnam pa'i dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ ldog pa'i dbye ba/ lus kyi dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ lus ci snyed par phye ba'i dbye ba/ rgyun gyis dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ skad cig snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma 'byung ba'i dbye ba/ phyi ltas kyi dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod yon la sred pa 'phel ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i dbye ba/ nang ltas kyi dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su mthun pa'i dbye ba/ rgyun ring ba'i dus kyi dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' nges pa med pa'i 'dus byas kyi dbye ba/ dus chad pas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ dus 'di tsam na rgyun chad pa'i nges pa can gyi dbye ba gang zhig rgyun chad kha min pa/ de'i dus kyi dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun chad kha'i skad cig tha ma'i dbye ba/ kun tu ston pa'i dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan snang du phung po sogs ston pa tsam gyi dbye ba/ bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdud byed kyi bsdu bya bsdus pa/ dbye na bcu gcig gi mtshan nyid kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid kyis mtshan gzhi ji snyed pa bsdus pa/ khams kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyus 'bras bu ji snyed pa bsdus pa/

rigs kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyis khyad par rnams bsdus pa/ gnas skabs kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnas skabs kyis gnas skabs can ji snyed pa bsdus pa/ grogs kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ grogs kyis grogs can ji snyed pa bsdus pa/ phyogs kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ phyogs kyis phyogs can ji snyed pa bsdus pa/ dus kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ dus kyis dus can ji snyed pa bsdus pa/ phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdud byed kyi phyogs gcig gis bsdu bya ji snyed pa bsdus pa/ mthar thug gis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdud byed mthar thug gis bsdu bya ji snyed pa kun bsdus pa/ gcig gis gcig bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsdu bya sdu byed phan tshun gcig gis gcig bsdus pa/ dam pa'i don gyis bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos nyid kyis chos can ci snyed pa bsdus pa/ mtshungs ldan gyis mtshan nyid/ grogs dang grogs can du gyur pa/ dbye na drug gi tshogs pa tha dad med pas mtshungs ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ tshogs pa gcig pa'i rdzas kyi rdul phran rnams go sa gcig tu 'jug pa/ 'dres pas mtshungs ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus pa gang zhig go sa dbyer med du 'dres pa/ phrad pas mtshungs ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ gong bu gnyis yul 'dab 'byor du phrad pa/ lhan cig 'byung bas mtshungs ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ rgyud gcig gis chos skye 'gag gnas pa'i ngang gcig pa/ bya ba bsgrubs pas mtshungs ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ bya ba mthun pa sgrub pa la phan tshun grogs byas nas 'jug pa/ mthun par rtogs pas mtshungs ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshungs ldan lngas mtshungs par ldan pa/ ldan pa'i mtshan nyid/ thob pa bzhin no// dbye na gsum gyi/ sa bon du ldan pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang 'bad med du ngang gis rgyud la 'byung rung du gnas pa'i gnas skabs/ dbye na nyon mongs dang*/ dge ba skyes thob dang*/ lung ma bstan skyes thob ste gsum mam de gsum khams gsum du phye ba'i sa bon du ldan pa dgu'o// dbang du ldan pa'i mtshan nyid/

chos gang nges par 'bad pa'i rkyen gyis brtas na/ rgyud la 'byung rung du gnas pa'i gnas skabs/ dbye na/ dge ba sbyor byung dang lung ma bstan sbyor byung dang*/ slob pa zag med dang*/ mi slob pa zag med dbang du ldan pa ste bzhi'o// mngon 'gyur du ldan pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis rgyud la gnas pa'i gnas skabs/ dbye na dge mi dge lung ma bstan mngon gyur du ldan pa gsum mo// de gsum ni bsdu ba'i rtsa ba dang 'grel pa ltar ro// bye bshad sogs chos spyi skad ltar na/ sa bon sogs gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ chos gang gis bzhag pa'i nus pa tsam gyi gnas skabs dang*/ chos gang gis nus pa rkyen la ltos nas rgyun gyis 'bras bu sgrub pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ nus pa can gyi rgyu rkyen las 'bras bu gang dngos su grub pa'i gnas skabs so// chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba las le'u dang po'i chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid te dang po'o// //bden pa rnam nges kyi mtshan nyid/ 'phags bzhi'i bden bzhi gtan la 'bebs byed/ de'i gtan la dbab bya 'phags pa'i bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pas 'di rnams ci lta bar gzigs pa/ bstan pa dang mthun pa/ dbye na/ sdug bsngal dang*/ kun 'byung dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam gyi bden pa bzhi'i dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu kun 'byung gis bskyed cing bstan pa dang mthun pa/ dbye na ma dag pa'i bcud dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ thun mong min pa'i rnam smin gyis bsdus pa'i phung po/ dbye na ngan 'gro dang*/ bde 'gro gnyis kyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mi dge bas 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na ngan song gsum gyi dmyal ba'i mtshan nyid/ mi dge ba chen pos 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na bco brgyad do// yi dwags kyi mtshan nyid/

mi dge ba 'bring gis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na gsum mam so drug go /dud 'gro'i mtshan nyid/ mi dge ba chung ngus 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na gnyis so// bde 'gro'i mtshan nyid/ dge bas 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na lnga ste/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ 'dod lha dang*/ gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med khams kyi lha'o// mi'i mtshan nyid/ bsod nams kyi las chung ngus 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na bzhi'am brgyad do// gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsod nams kyi las 'bring gis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ yang na 'dod pa'i bde 'gro gang zhig 'dod lha 'og gnyis kyi dgra zlar gyur pa/ dbye na/ gnas bzhi'i dbye bas bzhi'o// 'dod lha'i mtshan nyid/ bsod nams kyi las chen pos 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba/ dbye na drug go /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ mi g.yo ba'i las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba gang zhig gzugs la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba/ dbye na bcu bdun no// lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral ba/ dbye na bzhi'o// sdug bsngal gyi skabs yin pas bde 'gro rnams kyang 'khor ba pa'i dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid do// ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten gyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong ba'i las zag bcas kyi bdag 'bras gang zhig rgyud kyis ma bsdus par snang ba'i phung po/ dmigs bsal dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gang gis kyang ma bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing*/ dbye na gnyis kyi/ snod kyi mtshan nyid/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi zhing gang zhig las zag med kyi dbang 'bras/ bcud kyi mtshan nyid/ 'khor ba pa min pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag yang sdug bsngal brgyad kyi skye ba sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/

dogs pa sogs kyi sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa/ rgas pa sdug bsngal gyi/ na tshod 'gyur ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa sdug bsngal gyi/ yid du mi 'ong ba dang phrad pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa/ sdug pa dang bral ba sdug bsngal gyi/ yid du 'ong ba dang bral ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa/ 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal gyi/ re ba ma grub pas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa/ mdor na nyer len gyi phung po sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ gnas ngan len gyi sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa/ yang sdug bsngal gnyis kyi kun rdzob kyi bden par sdug bsngal ba'i mtshan nyid/ byis pas kyang mi 'dod pa'i rang bzhin du shes par nus pa/ dam pa'i don gyi bden par sdug bsngal ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa kho nas mi 'dod pa'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i zag bcas/ sdug bsngal spyi'i mtshan nyid/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med kyi rnam par rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya/ mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid/ skad cig ma/ yang na skye 'jig gi ngang can/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid/ mi 'dod pa'i ngang can du shes bya/ yang na zag pa dang bcas pas 'phags pa rnams dang mi mthun pa/ stong pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag don gzhan gyis stong pa/ dbye na gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gi stong pa gnyis kyi dang po'i mtshan nyid gang zhig bdag don gzhan gyis stong pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos kyi bdag tu btags pa'i kun btags kyis stong pa/ 'dir stong pa gsum gyi med pa'i stong pa'am rang stong kun btags kyi mtshan nyid sngar bzhin te/ dbye na gang zag dang chos su btags pa gnyis sam/ ngo bo dang khyad par du btags pa gnyis so// 'di rtog byed kyi blo'i yul du grub pas tha snyad du yod cing*/ btags pa ltar du rdzas su med pas don la med do// de bzhin du yod pa min pa'i stong nyid dam gzhan stong gzhan dbang la 'jog tshul gnyis kyi yang dag min rtog gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/

gang zag gam chos su snang ba'i gnyis snang gi shes pa/ dbye na ma dag gzhan dbang gnyis su snang ba ltar zhen pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa/ dag pa gzhan dbang gnyis su snang yang zhen pa med pa'i shes pa gnyis so// 'di ni rigs pas kyang dpyad bzod pa'i rdzas yin pa'i cha nas don dam dang*/ de kho na nyid mthong ba la sgrib pa'i cha nas kun rdzob bo// rkyen gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ dbye na 'dus byas zag bcas dang*/ zag med gnyis so// de ltar gzhan dbang kun btags kyis stong pa'i gzhan stong yin gyi/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i rang stong ni min no// stong pa'i rang bzhin yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag gis stong pa'i dbyings/ dbye na rang bzhin gyis dang rnam dag gis yongs su grub pa gnyis so// yang na yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi yul du grub pa/ dbye na gnyis kyi/ 'gyur med yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ sngar bzhin te 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi ye shes kyi don dam pa'i tshul gyis rtogs cing rang gi chos can gzhan dbang dang zung du 'jug gi phan tshun mi stong ngo*// des na stong gzhi gzhan dbang dang stong bya kun btags dang stong pa'i ngo bor 'gyur med yongs grub bo// phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag tu mi snang ba'i ye shes/ yul gyi gnas lugs bdag med pa ltar blo la'ang bdag tu mi snang bas phyin ci ma log pa dang*/ sgrib pa'i kun rdzob kyang min gyi/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gis rang rig pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i don dam nyid yin pas yongs grub bo// bdag med kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag med pa/ 'dir srid pa bzhi'i skye srid kyi mtshan nyid/ 'gro bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i skad cig gi srid pa/ sngon dus kyi srid pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'gro bar skyes nas mi 'chi'i bar gyi srid pa/ 'chi srid kyi mtshan nyid/

'gro ba'i srog chad pa'i skad cig gi srid pa/ bar srid kyi mtshan nyid/ 'gro ba nas shi nas 'gro bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i bar gyi srid pa/ skye gnas bzhi'i sgong skyes kyi mtshan nyid/ sgo ngar nang gi dbang po rim gyis grub pa'i sgo nas skye ba/ mngal skyes kyi/ sgo nga la ma ltos par mngal du dbang po rim gyis grub pa'i sgo nas skye ba/ drod gsher skyes kyi/ mngal dang sgo nga la ma ltos par phyi'am nang gi drod gsher las dbang po rim gyis grub pa'i sgo nas skye ba/ brdzus skyes kyi/ skye gnas su nying mtshams sbyar tsam gyis nang gi skye mched drug gcig car grub pa'i sgo nas skye ba/ kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal skyed byed bstan pa dang mthun pa/ dbye na las nyon gnyis kyi nyon mongs la rnam grangs nyer bzhi'i kun sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ sdug bsngal la kun tu sbyor bar byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na dgu'o// 'ching ba'i/ dge ba la sbyor ba na 'dod dgur byed pa mi 'thob pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// bag la nyal gyi/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags su gyur pa'i gnas ngan len/ dbye na bdun no// nye nyon gyi/ sems nye bar nyon mongs par byed pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na rtsa nyon dang nye nyon gnyis so// kun dkris kyi/ dge ba'i bar chad bya ba'i phyir yang yang sems kun nas 'khri bar byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na brgyad do// chu bo'i/ srid pa'i rgyun phyogs su 'khyer bar byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na bzhi'o// sbyor ba'i/ spang bya dang 'bral ba'i bar du gcod pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na bzhi'o// nyer len gyi/ yang srid nye bar len par byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na bzhi'o// mdud pa'i/ dkrol dka' bas mnyam gzhag gi bar du gcod pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na bzhi'o// sgrib pa'i/ bslab pa gsum la sgrib par byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na lnga'o// tha ba'i/

gnyen po'i thong shol gyi sa glog dka' ba'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// dri ma'i/ 'chal tshul gyi sgo nas mi gtsang bar yid ches pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// sdig pa'i/ 'khor bar yang yang skye 'chi'i tshul gyis gnod pa byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// zug rngu'i/ mchog gsum dang bden bzhi la the tshom gyi sgo nas gdung bar byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// ci yang gi 'jigs 'khon dang bcas shing g.yeng ba mang po'i rgyu byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// nyes spyod gyi/ sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod 'dren par byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// rtsa ba'i/ mi dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// zag pa'i/ sems rnam par 'phro bar zag par byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// phongs pa'i/ lus sems la phungs pa'i sgo nas gnod pa byed pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na gsum mo// yongs gdung gi tshul min du 'dzin pas lus sems gdung bar byed pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na gsum mo// 'khrug pa'i/ mya ngan sogs kyi sems can rnams nyon mongs par byed pa'i sems byung*/ dbye na gsum mo// 'thab pa'i/ 'thab rtsod kyi rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// rims nad kyi/ yongs gdung chen po byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// nags sbyor gyi/ skye ba'i rtsa ba 'du byed kyi nags tshal la chags par byed pa'i nyon mongs/ dbye na gsum mo// gegs kyi/ dge ba la sbyor ba'i gegs byed pa'i nyon mongs/ ris la gnyis kyi/ mthong spangs nyon mongs kyi/ sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa kun btags su gyur pa/ dbye na chags sogs nyon mongs bcus bden bzhi so so la log par zhugs pa'i mthong spangs 'dod khams na bzhi bcu dang*/ khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro bzhi bzhi med pas so drug ste brgya rtsa bcu gnyis/

sgom spangs nyon mongs kyi/ gegs byed pa lhan skyes su gyur pa rab tu ma zhi ba/ dbye na/ 'dod khams na/ 'jigs lta dang mthar lta lhan skyes gnyis dang*/ chags khro gnyis dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ ma rig pa ste drug dang*/ gong ma gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs pa lnga lnga ste bcu drug go /de rnams la sa dgu dang che 'bring dgus phye na khong khro dgu dang*/ lnga la brgyad cu rtsa gcig re ste bzhi brgya bcu bzhi'o// las kyi kun 'byung gi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i las/ dbye na sems pa dang bsam pa'i las gnyis te/ de dag bye brag smra bas/ yid kyi skye mched dang mtshungs ldan kyi sems pa dang*/ des kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi las gzugs can du 'dod la/ mdo sde pa ni/ lus ngag bem po las min gyi sems pa kho na las yin pas de dag yid 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa dang*/ lus ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa la 'dod do// sems tsam pa'ang las mtshan nyid pa sems pa la 'dod cing*/ 'dir sems pa'i las la bsod nams sogs gsum dang*/ bsam pa'i las la'ang sgo gsum gyi las gsum bshad pa ni phan tshun mtshon pa yin pas de dag re re la'ang sgo gsum gyi las gsum gsum yod pas sems pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ dge ba'am mi dge ba las sems mngon par 'du byed pa'i sems pa rgyu'i kun slong gis bsdus pa/ dbye na bsod nams sogs gsum gyi cha'o// bsam pa'i las kyi/ dge ba'am mi dge ba la sgo gsum gang rung 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa dus kyis kun slong gis bsdus pa/ dbye na sgo gsum gyi las gsum gyi cha'o// lus kyi las kyi/ dge ba'am mi dge ba la sgo gsum gang rung 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ ngag gi las kyi/ dge ba'am mi dge ba la ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ yid kyi las kyi/ dge ba'am mi dge ba la 'jug pa'i yid tsam dang mtshungs par ldan zhing lus ngag gang yang 'jug par mi byed pa'i sems pa/

de gsum la sems pa dang bsam pa'i las gnyis gnyis yod par mngon zhing*/ dge mi dge gnyis gnyis su yod de/ de'ang skabs 'dir bstan gyi dbang du byas so// spyir sgo gsum gyi lung ma bstan gyi las kyang yod pas de lta na mtshan nyid kyi zur gyi dge mi dge ces sogs kyi tshig zur dor ro// dge ba'i las lam bcu'i srog gcod spong ba'i las lam gyi mtshan nyid/ srog gcod spong ba'i lus 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ma byin len spong ba'i/ ma byin len spong pa'i lus 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ 'dod log spong ba'i bsgre'o// rdzun sogs bzhi spong ba'i rim pa ltar rdzun spong ba dang*/ phra ma dang ngag rtsub dang tshig 'khyal spong ba'i ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ yid kyi dge ba'i las gsum gyi rim pa ltar/ ma chags pa dang byams pa dang yang dag pa'i lta ba dang lhan cig pa'i sems pa/ mi dge ba'i las lam bcu'i srog gcod pa'i las lam gyi mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs can gyi sems kyis bsam bzhin du ma nor bar gzhan bsad pa'i lus 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ma byin len gyi/ nyon mongs can gyi sems kyis gzhan gyi nor mthu'am 'jab bus ma nor bar bdag gir byed pa'i lus 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ 'dod log gi nyon mongs can gyi sems kyis bgrod bya min pa la ma nor bar rang gis bgrod pa'i lus 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ rdzun gyi/ 'du shes bsgyur te mi bden pa'i don nyon mongs can gyis go bar brjod pa'i ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ phra ma'i/ pha rol dbye ba'i ched du nyon mongs can gyis go bar brjod pa'i ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ ngag rtsub kyi/ nyon mongs can gyis go bar gzhan gyi zhe 'gems pa'i ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/ ngag 'khyal gyi/ nyon mongs can gyi ngag 'jug par byed pa'i sems pa/

brnab sems kyi/ log pas gzhan gyi nor la chags pa'i 'dod chags dang lhan cig pa'i sems pa/ gnod sems kyi/ sems can la sdang ba'i zhe sdang dang lhan cig pa'i sems pa/ log lta'i las lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rgyu 'bras la skur pa 'debs pa'i lta ba dang lhan cig pa'i sems pa/ bsam bzhin pa las gyur pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ blo sngon du btang nas byas pa'i las/ dbye na lnga'am dge mi dge gnyis so// yang las mu bzhi'i byas shing bsags pa'i las kyi/ lus sam ngag gi las dngos su spyad cing rnam smin gyi bag chags 'phel ba'i las/ ma byas kyang bsags pa'i las kyi/ lus ngag gi dngos su ma spyad kyang yid kyis spyad pas sems rgyud la rnam smin gyi bag chags 'phel ba'i las/ byas kyang ma bsags pa'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ lus sam ngag gis dngos su spyad kyang rnam smin myong bar ma nges pa'i las/ ma byas shing ma bsags pa'i las kyi/ lus ngag gis kyang ma spyad cing rgyud la rnam smin 'phel ba min pa'i las/ yang las gnyis kyi 'phen byed kyi las kyi/ rnam smin 'phen byed kyi las/ rdzogs byed kyi las kyi/ 'phen byed kyis 'phangs pa 'dod pa'am mi 'dod pa myong byed kyi las/ yang las gsum gyi bsod nams kyi las kyi/ 'dod khams kyi rnam smin 'phen pa'am rdzogs byed kyi dge ba kun nas slong ba'i sems pa/ bsod nams min pa'i las kyi/ mi dge ba kun nas slong byed kyi sems pa/ mi g.yo ba'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ khams gong ma'i rnam smin 'phen pa'am rdzogs byed kyi dge ba kun nas slong ba'i sems pa/ de gsum la sems pa dang bsam pa'i las gnyis gnyis yod do// yang las bzhi'i las thun mong ba'i/ gtso bor snod kyi 'jig rten grub pa'i las/ las thun mong min pa'i/ sems can gyi 'jig rten 'phen pa'i las/ las stobs ldan gyi mthu che ba'i las/ stobs dang mi ldan pa'i las kyi/ mthu chung ba'i las/ yang las gsum gyi sdom pa'i las kyi/

sdig pa spong pa'i tshul khrims/ sdom min gyi las kyi/ bya ba min pa la mtha' gcig tu zhugs pa'i sems pa/ bar ma'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ sdom pa dang sdom min gang yang min zhing dge mi dge gang rung yin pa/ sdom pa la dbye na/ so thar dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ zag med kyi sdom pa gsum gyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i 'dod pa na spyod pa'i tshul khrims/ dbye na brgyad kyi/ dge slong pha ma'i sdom pa'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ lus ngag gi spang bya kun spong bas khyad par du byas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa gang zhig skyes pa la brten pa dang*/ bud med la brten pa dge slob ma'i sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i chos drug dang nye ba'i chos drug la slob pas khyad par du byas pa'i sdom pa gang zhig bud med la brten pa dang*/ dge tshul pha ma'i sdom pa'i/ rim pa ltar/ lus ngag gi spang bya bcu gtso bor spong bas khyad par du byas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa gang zhig skyes pa la brten pa dang*/ bud med la brten pa/ dge bsnyen pha ma'i sdom pa'i/ rim pa ltar lus ngag gi spang bya lnga'i bar spong bas khyad par du byas pa'i khyim pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa gang zhig skyes pa la brten pa dang bud med la brten pa/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'i/ lus ngag gi spang bya brgyad spong bas khyad par du byas pa'i khyim pa'i phyogs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ dge bsnyen la dbye na/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa dang*/ sna gcig spyod pa dang*/ phyogs 'ga' spyod pa dang*/ phal cher spyod pa dang*/ yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ go ma'i dge bsnyen te bdun no// zhar byung za ma'i mtshan nyid/ pho mo'i dbang po gang yang med pas sdom pa'i rten du mi rung ba'i mi'i 'gro ba/ ma ning gi mtshan nyid/ pho mo'i dbang po med pa'am yod kyang dga' ba'i don byed mi nus pas sdom pa'i rten du mi rung ba'i mi'i 'gro ba/

dbye na lnga ste/ mngon pa'i lugs yin gyi 'dul bar gzhan du'ang gsungs so// bsam gtan gyi sdom pa'i/ 'jig rten pa'i mnyam gzhag las skyes pa'i gzugs na spyod pa'i tshul khrims/ dbye na zag bcas kyi bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdog bzhi dang dngos gzhi'i bzhi ste brgyad las skyes ba brgyad dam skye 'phags gnyis kyi rgyud la yod pa gnyis so// zag med kyi sdom pa'i/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mnyam gzhag las skyes pa'i zag med kyi tshul khrims/ dbye na zag med kyi bsam gtan sa drug las skyes pa drug gam theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa gsum mo// yang las gsum gyi/ bde ba myong 'gyur gyi las kyi mtshan nyid/ tshor ba bde ba'i sa pa'i dge ba'i las/ sdug bsngal myong 'gyur gyi las kyi/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi sa pa'i mi dge ba'i las/ btang snyoms myong 'gyur gyi las kyi/ tshor ba btang snyoms kho na'i sa pa'i dge ba'i las/ yang gsum gyi/ mthong chos la myong 'gyur gyi las kyi/ las byas pa'i tshe de nyid la las de'i 'bras bu myong ba'i las/ skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las kyi/ las byas pa'i 'gro ba phyi ma phan chad la las de'i rnam smin myong ba'i las/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las kyi/ las byas pa'i 'gro ba gnyis pa phan chad nas brtsams te las de'i rnam smin myong ba'i las/ yang bzhi'i las dang rnam smin gnyis ka gnag pa'i las kyi/ mi dge ba'i las/ las dang rnam smin gnyis ka dkar ba'i las kyi/ khams gsum pa'i dge ba'i las/ las dang rnam smin gnyis ka 'dren ma'i las kyi/ 'dod pa'i bsam sbyor dge mi dge 'dren ma'i las/ mi gnag cing dkar la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur zhing zag bcas kyi las zad par 'gyur ba'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ spong gnyen gyis bsdus pa'i zag med kyi las/ yang sbyin khrims sgom gsum yon nyes rtog gsum dang gtsang ba dang thub pa pa'i sogs du ma yod do// kun 'byung spyi'i mtshan nyid/

rgyu kun 'byung rab skye rkyen gyi rnam par rnal 'byor bas sgom bya/ rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ yang srid kyi bag chags 'jog pa'i byed rgyu/ kun 'byung gi las kyi bag chags mthun par bsags pa rnams 'gro ba ris mthun par 'byung ba'i byed rgyu/ rab skye'i/ 'gro ba ris mthun pa rnams kyang rnam pa so so tha dad par 'byung ba'i byed rgyu/ rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ lus ma thob pa 'thob pa dang*/ thob pa 'da' ba'i byed rgyu/ 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings gang zhig bstan pa dang mthun pa/ rang rgyu lam bden gyi bral 'bras 'dus ma byas gang zhig bstan pa dang mthun pa zhes pa'ang rung ngo*// 'gog bden tsam la dbye na/ gnyis kyi brda'i 'gog pa'i/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis spang bya'i sa bon nyams smad pas thob pa'i 'gog pa/ don dam pa'i 'gog pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i shes rab kyis spang bya'i sa bon drung phyung ba'i 'gog pa/ de la dbye na gnyis kyi/ yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i 'gog pa'i/ 'phags pa slob pa'i 'bras bur bsdus pa'i 'gog pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'gog bden gyi/ mi slob pa'i 'bras bur bsdus pa'i 'gog pa/ de la gnyis kyi rgyan med pa'i 'gog bden gyi/ dgra bcom shes rab kyis rnam grol gyi 'bras bur bsdus pa'i 'gog pa/ rgyan dang bcas pa'i 'gog bden gyi/ dgra bcom gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi 'bras bur bsdus pa'i 'gog pa/ yang gsum gyi lhag bcas kyi 'gog bden gyi/ nyon mongs spangs shing sdug bsngal gyi phung po'i lhag ma dang bcas pa'i 'gog pa/ lhag med kyi 'gog bden gyi/ zag bcas kun 'gog pa'i theg dman gyi 'gog pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'gog bden gyi/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i 'gog pa/ 'gog bden spyi'i mtshan nyid/ 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges 'byung gi rnam par rnal 'byor pas sgom bya/ 'gog pa sogs bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/

nyon mongs dang bral ba'i dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i dang*/ gtsang ba dang bde ba'i dang*/ rtag pa dang phan pa'i dbyings/ lam bden gyi mtshan nyid/ thar par phyin byed zag med bstan pa dang mthun pa/ dbye na gsum gyi/ nyan thos kyi lam bden gyi/ nyan thos kyi thar par byin byed zag med bstan pa dang mthun pa/ rang rgyal dang theg chen gyi lam bden la bsgre'o// yang thar lam gyi mtshan nyid/ myong 'das su phyin byed kyi lam/ dbye na nyan rang byang sems kyi lam gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas drod ma skyes gong gi myang 'das su phyin byed kyi lam/ yang chung 'bring chen po gsum dang*/ skabs su gtogs pa dang*/ mos pa las gyur pa dang*/ lhag par mos pa las gyur pa dang*/ thos pa las gyur pa ste bzhi'o// sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg pa dang sgom pa po rang rang gi tshogs lam rdzogs kyi rjes mthong lam ma skyes kyi sngar myang 'das su phyin byed kyi lam/ dbye na/ theg pa'i sbyor lam gsum gyi mtshan nyid bsgre'o// yang drod sogs bzhi dang*/ chung 'bring chen po gsum dang*/ rjes su mthun pa ba dang*/ khyad par ba dang*/ rtogs pa ba dang*/ yongs su sgyur ba pa dang*/ skye ba gcig pa ba dang*/ stan gcig pa ba ste drug go /mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg pa dang sgom pa po so so'i sbyor lam rdzogs kyi rjes 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam skyes kyi sngar myang 'das su phyin byed kyi lam/ dbye na theg pa'i mthong lam gsum dang*/ skad cig ma bcu drug sogs so// sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid gsar du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig sdug bsngal mthong spang gi gnyen po bar chad med lam gyis bsdus pa/ sdug bsngal la chos shes kyi/ sdug bsngal mthong spang dang bral ba'i gnas gyur gsar ba mngon du byed pa'i ye shes rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa/

sdug bsngal la rjes bzod kyi/ sdug bsngal la chos bzod chos shes gnyis 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyur gsar du rtogs pa'i ye shes bzod pas bsdus pa/ sdug bsngal la rjes shes kyi/ sdug bsngal la rjes bzod gsar du rtogs pa'i ye shes shes pas bsdus pa/ gzhan bcu gnyis la'ang bsgre'o// sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg pa dang gang zag so so'i mthong lam rdzogs kyi rjes mi slob lam ma skyes kyi sngar myang 'das su phyin byed kyi lam/ dbye na theg pa'i sgom lam gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ sngar gyi bsgre'o// yang mnyam rjes gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ sgom lam gang zhig lam sgom pa la gnas pa dang*/ de las langs ba'i bya ba/ yang 'jig rten pa dang de las 'das pa'i sgom lam gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar/ sgom lam gang zhig zhi rags kyi rnam pa can dang bden pa'i rnam pa can/ de dag gi mtshan gzhir bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi sa yin pas gtan la dbab bar bya ste/ de dag gi spyi'i mtshan nyid/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i sas bsdus pa/ de la sa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi ste brgyad las bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi sa tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sa gang zhig gzugs kyi sas bsdus pa dang gzugs med kyi sas bsdus pa/ bsam gtan dang po'i mtshan nyid/ yid mi bde las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam gtan gang zhig rtog dpyod gang rung gis bsdus pa/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid tshor ba sdug bsngal dang rtog dpyod zag bcas las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam gtan gang zhig ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba'i sa pa/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i mtshan nyid yid bde zag bcas las nges par 'byung ba'i bde ba'i sa pa'i bsam gtan gang zhig tshor ba dga' ba'i sa pa min pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid tshor ba bde ba zag bcas las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam gtan gang zhig tshor ba dga' bde'i sa min pa/

nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi mtshan nyid gzugs kyi 'du shes las nges par 'byung ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig nam mkha'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi/ nam mkha'i 'du shes las nges par 'byung ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig rnam shes kyi 'du shes dang ma bral ba/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi/ rnam shes mtha' yas kyi 'du shes las nges par 'byung ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig ci yang med pa'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi/ ci yang med pa'i 'du shes las nges par 'byung ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig 'du shes yod min med min gyi 'du shes dang ma bral ba/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na nyon mongs can dang dag pa ba dang zag med gsum gyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mnyam gzhag gi sa gang zhig nyon mongs kyi rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa/ dbye na sred pa dang*/ lta ba dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ ma rig pa shas che ba'i snyoms 'jug bzhi'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la ro myong ba'i sgo nas rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis pa'i/ lta ba shas che ba'i sgo nas rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa'i snyoms 'jug gsum pa'i/ nga rgyal shas che ba'i sgo nas rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa thar ba yin min the tshom za ba shas che ba'i sgo nas rab tu ma zhi bar byas pa'i snyoms 'jug dag pa pa'i mtshan nyid/ mnyam bzhag gi sa gang zhig 'jig rten pa'i dge ba rtse gcig pas bsdus pa/ dbye na nyams pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ khyad par dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig nyon mongs skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ gnyis pa'i/ de gang rang sa'i dag pa ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ gsum pa'i/ de gang gong sa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ bzhi pa'i/

de gang zag med kyi lam skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa/ srid rtse la gsum pa ma gtogs pa'i gang zag gsum mo// zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ mnyam bzhag gi sa gang zhig 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge bas bsdus pa/ srid rtse la 'di bor ba gnyis dang*/ nyer bsdog dang po bor ba bdun la nyon mongs can yang med pas dag pa ba kho na dang*/ nyer bsdogs dang po la ni zag med dang dag pa ba gnyis te kha cig nyon mongs can yang 'dod do// sbyor dngos kyi sgo nas dbye na/ dngos gzhi dang nyer bsdog gnyis kyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'og sa las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag gi sa gang zhig mi lcogs med yin par 'gal ba/ dbye na bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi gnyis kyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang rang rang gi yan lag gi sgo nas sa gzhan las khyad zhugs pa/ dbye na bzhi'i bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i bsam gtan gang zhig rtog dpyod gang rung gi sa pa/ dbye na gnyis kyi/ dngos gzhi tsam po'i mtshan nyid/ de gang rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa/ dngos gzhi khyad par can gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang rtog pa med la dpyod pa tsam gyi sa pa/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan dang po las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i bsam gtan gang zhig ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba'i sa pa/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan gnyis pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i tshor ba bde ba'i sa pa'i mnyam gzhag gang zhig tshor ba dga' ba'i sa pa min pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i bsam gtan gang zhig tshor ba dga' ba'i sa ba min pa/ gnyis pa gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa gang zhig rang rang gi dmigs pa'i sgo nas sa gzhan las khyad zhugs pa/ dbye na bzhi'i/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/

bsam gtan bzhi pa las 'dod chags dang bral pa'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig rang gi snyoms 'jug sbyor ba'i tshe nam mkha' kho na la dmigs par byed pa/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig rang gi snyoms 'jug sbyor ba'i tshe rnam shes mtha' yas kho na la dmigs par byed pa/ ci yang med pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig rang gi snyoms 'jug sbyor ba'i tshe gzung bya ci yang med pa kho na la dmigs par byed pa/ srid rtse'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gzugs med kyi sa gang zhig 'du shes gsal po med cing gtan med kyang ma yin pa/ gnyis pa nyer bsdog gi mtshan nyid/ 'og sa las 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i lam gang zhig gong ma'i dngos gzhi 'thob pa'i sbyor ba/ sa'i sgo nas dbye na brgyad kyi/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdog gi mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa las 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i lam gang zhig bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi thob pa'i sbyor ba zhes pa'i rigs pa gzhan bdun la bsgre'o// yid byed kyi rim pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa dang*/ mos pa las byung ba dang*/ rab tu dben pa las byung ba dang*/ dga' ba sdud pa dang*/ dpyod pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtha'i yid byed drug go /mtshan nyid rim pa ltar 'og sa las chags pa dang bral ba'i ched du sa gong 'og la zhi rags su lta ba'i yid byed dang po dang*/ sa gong 'og zhi rags su sgom byung kho nas rtse gcig tu sgom pa'i yid byed gnyis pa dang*/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs chen po gsum spong bzhin pa'i yid byed dang*/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs 'bring gsum spong bzhin pa'i yid byed dang*/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs phal cher spangs shing 'gog pa'i nyon mongs spangs ma spangs dpyod pa'i yid byed dang*/

'og sa'i nyon mongs chung ngu gsum spong bzhin pa'i yid byed do// sa brgyad so so'i nyer bsdog gi yid byed drug la'ang rigs pa bsgre'o// rgyu 'bras kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyu snyoms 'jug dang 'bras bu skye ba gnyis kyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug dge ba rtse gcig pa 'khor bcas gang zhig khams gong du skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ dbye na khams gong mar 'phen byed kyi snyoms 'jug sa rang rang gi bar chad med lam gyi nyer bsdog gsum gsum dang*/ rdzogs byed kyi snyoms 'jug rang rang gi dngos gzhi chung 'bring chen por sgom pa gsum gsum mo// 'di la zag med dang nyon mongs can ni med kyi dag pa ba kho na ste/ lung ma bstan dang zag med kyis rnam smin mi 'phen pas so// des na gnas gtsang mar skye ba'i rgyu spel sgom ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'i nyer bsdog bar chad med lam gyi bsam gtan bzhi par 'phang shing bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi chen por bsgom pas 'bras bu cher rdzogs par byas pa'i skye ba 'ga' zhig len pa'i las kyi sa bon rnams mi che ba sogs sngar sgyur byed nyid yin gyi 'phen rdzogs kyi rgyu snyoms 'jug min no// 'bras bu skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi rgyu snyoms 'jug gi 'bras bu ris mthun bzung ba nyid kyis thob pa'i mnyam bzhag gi sa gang zhig rang sas bsdus pa/ dbye na sa'i sgo nas brgyad do// bsam gtan dang po'i 'bras bu skye ba'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug gi 'bras bu ris mthun bzung ba nyid kyis thob pa'i mnyam gzhag gi sa gang zhig rang sas bsdus pa ces sogs bsgre'o// ngo bo'i sgo nas nyon mongs can sogs gsum ste srid rtse la zag med med do// rdzogs byed kyi 'bras bu yi sgo nas dang po gsum la gnas gzhan gyis skye ba gsum gsum dang bzhi pa la so skye'i gsum dang 'phags pa'i lnga ste brgyad dang*/

gzugs med bzhi po re re la dma' zhing ngan pa dang mtho zhing ngan pa'am dma' zhing bzang ba dang mtho zhing bzang ba ste gsum gsum mo// sbyor ba nyer bsdog kyi dbye ba ni med do// yang sgom lam la dbye na chung 'bring dgu'i sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo skal gyi sgom spangs chen po'i chen po spong byed kyi lam zhes sogs bsgre'o// yang lam bzhi'i sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi spang bya'i sa bon gyi cha shas re re nas spong ba'i lam/ bar chad med lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi spang bya'i sa bon kun spong bzhin pa'i lam/ de'ang 'jig rten pas spang bya'i sa bon mgo gnon pa'i tshul gyis spong la/ 'das lam gyis sa bon drung 'byin pa'i sgo nas spong ngo*// rnam grol lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi spang bya spangs pa'i gnas gyur gsar pa mngon du byed pa'i lam/ khyad par gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam grol lam gyi 'og tu lam snga ma'i spangs ba khyad par du byed pa'i lam/ dbye na ye shes bshes gnyen kyis spangs ba khyad par gyi ched du ba'i lam/ chos sems pa la sogs pa khyad par gyi ched du ba'i lam/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi lam ste gsum du phye'o// yang gnyen po bzhi'i rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ thog mar spang bya la nyes dmigs can du lta ba'i lam/ spong ba gnyen po'i rang gi spang bya'i sa bon spong bzhin pa'i lam/ rten gnyen po'i/ spangs pa'i thob pa kun tu 'dzin pa tsam gyi lam/ thag sring pa'i gnyen po'i/ sngar spong gnyen gyis spangs pa'i spang bya thag sring bar byed pa'i lam/ spang lam bcu gcig gi dang po bdun byang chub phyogs mthun yin pas de'i mtshan nyid/ zad mi skye shes pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos/ dbye na bdun gyi dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/ lus tshor sems chos gang rung la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis rtog pa'i dran pa dang shes rab/

dbye na bzhi'i lus dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/ lus la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis rtog pa'i dran pa dang shes rab/ ces pa gzhan gsum la bsgre'o// yang dag spong ba'i/ spang gnyen la blang dor rtsom pa'i brtson 'grus/ dbye na bzhi'i mi dge ba skyes pa spong ba'i yang dag 'jog gi mtshan nyid/ spang bya skyes pa 'dor ba'i ched du brtson pa'i brtson 'grus/ gzhan gsum la bsgre'o// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pas sems gnas pa las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ dbye na/ 'dun brtson sems dpyod kyi ting nge 'dzin bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar/ gus sbyor dang*/ rgyun sbyor dang*/ sngon gyi skye bar goms pa dang*/ tshe 'dir chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa la brten nas thob pa'i sems rtse gcig pa'i blo/ 'di'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ drod rtse nas sgom bya'i rnam grangs dbang po gang zhig rang 'bras 'phags lam skyed pa la dbang byed pa/ dbye na/ dad brtson dran ting shes rab kyi dbang po lnga'i mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi la yid ches pa dang*/ bden bzhi sgom pa la spro ba dang*/ bden bzhi'i dmigs rnam ma brjed pa dang*/ bden bzhi la rtse gcig pa dang*/ bden bzhi rab tu 'byed pa'i rnam byang gi dbang po gang zhig drod rtse nas sgom par bya ba/ 'di'i stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ bzod mchog nas sgom bya'i rnam byang gi dbang po gang zhig rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis mi rdzi bar gyur pa/ dbye na lnga'i dad pa'i stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi la yid ches pa'i rnam byang gi dbang po gang zhig ma dad pas mi rdzi bar gyur pa/ de bzhin du gzhan bzhi'i mtshan nyid gang zhig yan chad dbang po ltar sbyar te le lo dang brjed ngas dang rnam g.yeng dang shes bzhin med pas mi rdzi bar gyur pa/ byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ thog mar bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam/ dbye na dran 'byed brtson dga' sbyangs ting nge 'dzin btang snyoms byang chub yan lag bdun/

mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ dge ba'i chos kun yid kyis brjod pa'i sgo nas byang chub kyi gnas kyi yan lag dang*/ mthong lam gyi rang bzhin yin pas byang chub kyi ngo bo'i yan lag dang*/ bgrod bya ci srid par 'gro ba'i sgo nas byang chub kyi nges 'byung gi yan lag dang*/ sems rgyud tshim par byed pa'i sgo nas byang chub kyi phan yon gyi yan lag dang*/ gnas ngan len 'jig pa'i sgo nas gang gis kyang nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ gnas gyur pa'i sgo nas gang du'ang nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ brnab sems dang yid mi bde dang bral ba'i sgo nas nyon mongs pa gang yang med pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu gyur pa/ 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang rnam par dag par nges par 'byin pa'i lam/ dbye na lta rtog ngag dang las kyi mtha'/ 'tsho rtsol dran ting yan lag brgyad/ mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ mnyam gzhag tu myong ba'i de kho na nyid nges par 'dzin pa'i 'phags lam yan lag dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta bas rtogs pa'i don gzhan la ston pa'i ngag kun nas slong ba'i 'phags lam yan lag rang smra ba po lta ba rnam dag tu gzhan yid ches pa'i 'phags lam yan lag dang*/ rang rgyud ldan tshul khrims rnam dag tu gzhan yid ches pa'i 'phags lam yan lag dang*/ rang rgyud ldan 'tsho ba rnam dag tu gzhan yid ches pa'i 'phags lam yan lag dang*/ sgom spang nyon grib sbyong ba'i 'phags lam yan lag dang*/ bying rgod sogs sgom spang nye nyon sbyong ba'i 'phags lam yan lag dang*/ mngon shes sogs yon tan khyad par can la sgrib pa sbyong ba'i 'phags lam yan lag tu gyur pa/ yang lam bzhi'i mngon shes bul la/ dka' ba'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbang po rtul po dngos gzhi'i bsam gtan ma thob pa'i lam/ ces sogs gzhan gsum la bsgre'o// chos kyi gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ bslab pa gsum gang rung spyod pa'i lam/

dbye na bzhi'o// lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ nges 'byung gis zin pa'i bslab pa gang zhig mi dge ba mngon gyur spong pas phye pa'i sdom pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i sa bon mgo gnon pas phye ba'i rtse gcig pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i sa bon drung 'byin pas phye ba'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed do// zhi gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa'i blo/ dbye na sems gnas thabs kyi sgo nas dgu/ sa'i sgo nas brgyad sogs tshul du mar dbyer rung ngo*// lhag mthong gi mtshan nyid/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo/ dbye na bzhi'o// dbang po gsum gyi mi shes pa kun shes pa'i dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ de kho na nyid gsar du shes par bya ba'i ched du zhugs pa'i lam la dbang byed pa'i dbang po/ bsdu bar tshogs lam nas dang*/ 'dir sbyor lam nas dang*/ mdzod du mthong lam skad cig dang po bco lnga nyid la bzhag go /kun shes pa'i dbang po'i/ de kho na nyid gsar du shes pa'i ched du ma zhugs pa'i dbang po gang zhig 'phags pa slob pa'i lam la dbang byed pa/ kun shes bsrung ba'i dbang po'i/ mi slob pa'i lam la dbang byed pa'i dbang po/ mthar phyin pa'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zag dang theg pa rang rang gi spangs rtogs phul du dbyung du med par son zhing phyin par byed pa'i lam/ dbye na theg pa gsum gyi lam mo// yang zad pa shes pa dang mi skye ba shes pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar/ kun 'byung ma lus par zad nas skyes pa'i bden bzhi shes pa'i ye shes sam kun 'byung zad pa'i 'gog pa la dmigs pa mi slob pa'i ye shes dang*/ sdug bsngal kun gtan mi skye bar spangs nas skyes pa'i bden bzhi shes pa'i ye shes sam sdug bsngal mi skye ba'i 'gog pa la dmigs pa'i mi slob pa'i ye shes/ yang mi slob pa'i chos bcur dbyer yod do// lam bden spyi'i mtshan nyid/

lam rigs pa sgrub pa nges 'byin gyi rnam par rnal 'byor pas sgom bya/ lam sogs bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar de kho na'i don yongs su tshol ba'i dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i dang*/ sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'i dang*/ gtan du grol bar 'gro ba'i ye shes/ chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba las le'u gnyis pa'i chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid ste gnyis pa'o// //chos gsung rab kyi mtshan nyid/ tshig rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i gsung*/ yang na bka'i mtshan nyid/ spobs pa bzhi ldan gyi gsung rab gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos sku'i bdag rkyen las byung ba/ dbye na zhal nas gsung pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa gsum dang*/ de la'ang sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum mo// dus kyi sgo nas chos 'khor rim pa gsum mo// rjod byed kyi sgo nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ mdo'i sde'i mtshan nyid/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis lhug pa 'ba' zhig gsung pa'i mdo/ dbyangs kyi bsnyad pa'i sde'i/ dbus dang mthar tshigs su bcad de dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i mdo'i sde'am drang don gyi mdo sde gang rung yin pa/ lung du bstan pa'i sde'i/ gang dag 'das pa dang 'byung ba lung bstan pa'i mdo'am nges don gyi mdo sde gang rung yin pa/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde'i/ tshig bcad nyid du gsung pa'i mdo/ ched du brjod pa'i sde'i/ bstan pa gnas pa'i ched du yid rang nas brjod pa'i mdo/ gleng gzhi'i sde'i/ gang la gleng nas bslab pa bcas pa gsung pa'i mdo/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde'i/ dpe dang bcas par gsungs pa'i mdo/ de lta bu byung ba'i sde'i/ sngon gyi tshe rabs rgyud pa'i sbyor ba ston pa'i mdo/ skyes pa'i rabs kyi sde'i/ byang sems kyi sngon gyi spyod pa ston pa'i mdo/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde'i/ byang sems kyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ston pa'i mdo/

rmad du byung ba'i sde'i/ 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar rmad byung ston pa'i mdo/ gtan la dbab pa'i sde'i/ chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par gtan la 'bebs pa'i mdo/ brjod bya'i sgo nas sde snod gsum gyi mdo sde'i sde snod kyi mtshan nyid/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo/ nyon mongs kyi gnyen po'i sgo nas brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo*// bka'i dgong 'grel bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis bka'i don bshad pa'i gsung gang zhig thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa/ bka' yang bstan bcos su bsdus pa'i rang rig pa'i bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i gsung rabs/ bstan bcos tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ rjod byed du snang ba'i sgo nas slob pa'i blo 'chos par byed pa/ dbye na don med don log don dang ldan pa gsum mo// gsung rab kyi yul can thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar yid ches pa'i gsung rab las skyes pa dang*/ rigs pas nges par bsam pa las skyes pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo/ khyab pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgom byung tsam gyi dmigs pa/ dbye na bzhi'i rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs can gyi mtshan nyid/ shes bya'i dngos po dang cha 'dra ba'i gzugs can gang zhig mos pa yid byed kyi zhi lhag gi dmigs pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzugs can gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig de kho na nyid yid byed kyi zhi lhag gi dmigs pa/ dngos po'i mtha'i mtshan nyid/ ci lta ba'am ci snyed pa shes pa'i dmigs pa/

dgos pa grub pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa tshul bzhin bsgoms pas gnas gyur pa/ stong nyid dang smon med dang mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rim pa ltar/ bdag tu mi rtog pa'i dang*/ khams gsum la mi smon pa'i dang*/ mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam thar sgo gsum la bdag tu mi rtog pa'i zag med kyi ting nge 'dzin ces sogs sbyar ro// spyod pa rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs rnam rtog shas che ba'i gnyen po sgom bya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa/ dbye na 'dod chags sogs lnga la spyod pa rnam par sbyong ba lnga'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dang nga rgyal dang rnam rtog shas che ba'i gnyen por sgom bya'i mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang rten 'brel sgom pa'i ting 'dzin dang khams kyi rab tu dbye ba sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dbugs 'byung rngub dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa so sor sbyar ro// mkhas pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ mkhas par sbyang dgos pa'i shes bya/ dbye na lnga'i/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ mthun pa'i rgyu las mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'i cha/ nyon mongs pa sbyong ba'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon gyi gnyen por sgom bya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa/ dbye na/ nyon mongs kyi sa bon mgo gnon pa dang*/ drung 'byin pas sbyong pa'i dmigs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can dang bdag med kyi rnam pa can gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa/ gsung rab la dpyod pa'i rigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos rnams tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i 'thad pa/ dbye na/ ltos pa dang*/ bya ba byed pa dang*/ gtan tshigs sgrub pa dang*/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ 'bras bu 'byung ba rang gi rgyu rkyen la ltos pa'i dang*/ rgyu rkyen gyis rang 'bras la bya ba byed pa'i dang*/
