rtags yan lag gi bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i dang*/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin de las mi 'da' ba'i 'thad pa/ kun tu tshol ba'i mtshan nyid/ ming don 'brel pa dang bcas pa'i gang rung glo bur du btags pa tsam du rtogs pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab/ dbye na ming dang*/ dngos po dang*/ ngo bo nyid du 'dogs pa dang*/ khyad par du 'dogs pa tshol ba bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ brjod bya la rjod byed glo bur du dang*/ brjod bya la brjod bya glo bur du dang*/ don gyi ngo bo'i brjod bya rjod byed kyi 'brel pa dang*/ don gyi khyad par gyi brjod bya rjod byed 'brel pa btags pa tsam du rtogs pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab/ yongs su shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ kun tu tshol bas btsal ba ltar shes pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab/ dbye na ming dang*/ dngos po dang*/ ngo bo nyid 'dogs pa dang*/ khyad par du 'dogs pa/ yang dag pa ci lta ba bzhin du yongs su shes pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ ming dang ming gi brjod pa ltar gyi dngos po dang ngo bo nyid rdzas su dang bye brag rdzas su mi dmigs par shes pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab/ rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi rnal 'byor gyi sbyor dngos 'bras bu gang rung gis bsdus pa/ dbye na lnga'i/ rnal 'byor gyi sbyor ba bzhi dang skyed pa'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i bden bzhi mang du thos pa'i thos byung gi dang*/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i thos pa'i don tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab/ ngo bo me long lta bu dang snang ba'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa dang*/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i chos nyid mngon sum du snang ba'i ye shes/ 'bras bu gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gnas gyur pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i ye shes/ mdo sde rgyan ltar na/ slob lam gnas gyur pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes/

chos dang don dang yi ge dang nges tshig dang sngon phyi'i mtha'i dgongs pa la mkhas pa lnga'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ gsung rab mang du thos pa'i shes rab dang*/ gsung rab kyi don shes pa dang*/ nges tshig bzang po'i yi ge shes pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi ljongs kyi ming la ma zhen par tha snyad byed pa shes pa dang*/ sngar zin pa'i chos rnams la brten te phyis dgongs pa rtogs pas thos pa tsam las nges par 'byung bar bya ba shes pa/ chos la gnas pa rdzogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ thos bsam dang sgom gnyis ka zung 'brel du sgrub pa/ shin tu rgyas par bstan pa phar phyin spyi'i mtshan nyid/ dam pa drug ldan gyi lam/ dbye na drug gi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar/ dam pa drug ldan gyi lam gang zhig ces kun la sbyar te/ sbyin bya'i rdzas gtong ba dang*/ nyes spyod spong ba'i sems pa dang*/ sran thub pa dang*/ dge ba la spro ba dang*/ sems rtse gcig pa dang*/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed/ dgongs ldem dgongs kyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar dgongs gzhi dang dgongs pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo/ dgongs pa la dbye na/ mnyam nyid dang*/ dus gzhan dang*/ don gzhan dang*/ gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ sangs rgyas la brnyas pa'i gnyen por chos sku mnyam pa dang*/ le lo'i gnyen por dus ring mo na de ltar 'gyur ba la dang*/ bden zhen gyi gnyen por ngo bo nyid gsum la dang*/ mchog 'dzin gyi gnyen por dman mchog gi ltos pa tha dad la dgongs nas gsung pa'i mdo/ ldem dgongs la dbye na gzhug pa dang*/ mtshan nyid dang*/ gnyen po dang*/ sgyur ba la ldem por dgongs pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ bstan pa la gzhug pa'i ched du don gzhan la dang*/ bden zhen gyi gnyen por don gzhan la dang*/ gdul bya nye ring la spang bya gang dang gang yod pa de'i gnyen por dgongs pa bzhi ci rigs pa la dgongs nas gsung pa'i mdo/ chos rtogs sla ba'i gnyen por dgongs gzhi'i brjod bya zab mo la dgongs nas rjod byed gzhan gyis gsungs pa'i mdo/

drang don dang nges don gyi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar/ dngos kyi brjod bya la gnod byed yod pas dgongs pa gzhan btsal dgos pa'i mdo/ dngos kyi brjod bya la gnod byed med pas dgongs pa gzhan btsal mi dgos pa'i mdo'o// chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba las le'u gsum pa'i chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid de gsum pa'o// //thob pa rnam nges la/ thob pa po gang zag dang*/ thob bya mngon rtogs dang*/ mngon rtogs su 'dus pa'i yon tan gsum gyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun gyis bsdus pa'i sems dang bcas pa'i phung po'i rgyun/ dbye na sde tshan bdun gyi dang po spyod pas rab tu dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ spang bya rgyud la bsten pas phye ba'i gang zag dbye na bdun gyi 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ 'dod chags shas che zhing rgyun ring ba'i gang zag zhe sdang dang gti mug dang nga rgyal rnam rtog la spyod pa bzhi la'ang bsgre'o// cha mnyam pa la spyod pa dang nyon mongs chung ba'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ rim pa ltar yul mthun par nyon mongs 'byung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa srab pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i gang zag gnyis pa nges par 'byung bas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ byang chub gsum gang rung du nges par 'byung bas phye ba'i gang zag dbye na nyan rang theg chen pa'i gang zag gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ rigs can gsum gyi nang nas rang bzhin gyi dbang po rtul 'bring rno ba'i gang zag go /yang na dngos po'i mtshan nyid/ nyan thos kyi lam gyis nyan thos kyi byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba'i gang zag dbye na nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan du mi 'gyur bar nyan thos kyi byang chub nyid du nges par 'byung ba'i dang*/ rkyen dbang gis theg pa gzhan gyi byang chub tu'ang nges par 'byung srid pa'i nyan thos/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyal gyi lam gyis rang rgyal gyi byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba'i gang zag

dbye na nges ma nges gnyis kyi mtshan nyid bsgre'o// yang bse ru dang tshogs spyod gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe rang dang theg pa gcig pa'i 'gran zla dang lhan cig mi gnas pa dang gnas pa'i rang rgyal gyi gang zag tshogs spyod la dbye na 'phags lam sngon du ma song ba dang song ba gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ slob dpon la dngos su ltos te mthong lam ma skyes pa dang rang rgyal tshogs spyod kyi gang zag theg chen pa dang dbye ba nges ma nges kyi mtshan nyid bsgre'o// sde tshan gsum pa nye bar brtan pas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ tshogs bsags ma bsags kyi phye ba'i gang zag dbye na tshogs sbyor ba gnyis kyi dang po la'ang tshogs lam pa tshogs ma bsags pa dang*/ bsags ma bsags gnyis ka dang*/ bsags pa gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ thar pa cha mthun chung 'bring chen po dang ldan zhing sbyor lam skye ba'i dus nges pa med pa dang*/ nges pa thob tsam dang tshe de nyid la skye ba'i gang zag so sor sbyar ro// sbyor lam pa gsum gyi'ang rim pa ltar/ nges 'byed cha mthun chung 'bring chen po dang ldan zhing mthong lam skye ba'i dus nges pa med pa dang dus nges pa thob tsam dang chos mchog pa min zhing mthong lam tshe de nyid la skye ba'i gang zag sde tshan bzhi pa sbyor bas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ bden pa mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir sbyor bas phye ba'i gang zag dbye na gnyis kyi dad pas rjes 'brang gi mtshan nyid/ tshogs lam rdzogs pa'i gang zag dbang rtul gang zhig gzhan gyis bstan pa tsam gyis rjes su 'brang nas bden pa mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir sbyor ba/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gi mtshan nyid/ tshogs lam rdzogs pa'i gang zag dbang rnon gang zhig bdag nyid kyis bden pa'i dbang du byas pa'i chos la dpyad nas bden pa mngon par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir sbyor ba/ sde tshan bzhi pa 'bras bus phye ba'i mtshan nyid/

zhugs 'bras gang rung gis phye ba'i gang zag dbye na nyer bdun gyi dad mos dang mthong thob kyi mtshan nyid/ slob pa'i 'bras gnas gang zhig dad pa dang shes rab lhag pas phye ba'i gang zag phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed kyi mtshan nyid/ rnam thar brgyad la snyoms par 'jug nus pa'i phyir mi 'ong*/ shes rab kyis dang gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam thar brgyad la snyoms par 'jug mi nus pa dang nus pa'i dgra bcom/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob don du brtson pa'i nyan thos zhugs pa/ dbye na rim skyes pa dang cig char ba'i rgyun zhugs zhugs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob don du brtson pa'i rim gyis pa dang*/ cig char ba'i nyan thos zhugs pa/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa ma spangs pa'i nyan thos 'bras gnas gang zhig phyir 'ong min pa/ dbye na rim gyis pa dang cig char gyi rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang 'dod nyon drug pa ma spangs pa'i rim gyis pa'i nyan thos 'bras gnas dang*/ sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa ma spangs pa'i cig char ba'i nyan thos 'bras gnas/ yang na rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnam pas rim gyis dang cig char spong bar 'gyur ba/ yang 'bras gnas tsam po dang khyad par can gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig 'bras bu phyi ma thob don du mi brtson pa dang brtson pa/ rim gyis pa'i tsam khyad gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig phyir 'ong thob don du mi brtson pa dang brtson pa/ cig char ba'i tsam khyad gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ cig car pa'i de gang zhig dgra bcom thob don du mi brtson pa dang brtson pa/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa'i/ phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu thob don du brtson pa'i nyan thos zhugs pa/ 'bras bu thod rgal ba'i dang mthar gyis pa'i phyir 'ong zhugs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/

rgyun zhugs ma thob pa dang thob zin nas phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu thob don du brtson pa'i nyan thos zhugs pa/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa ma spangs pa'i nyan thos 'bras gnas gang zhig rgyun zhugs min pa/ dbye na 'bras bu thod rgal ba dang rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ mthong lam ma thob gong du dang*/ rgyun zhugs mthong lam gyis thob zin nas sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa man chad gang rung spangs shing dgu pa ma spangs ba'i 'bras bu thod rgal ba dang rim gyis pa'i nyan thos 'bras gnas/ 'bras bu rim skyes pa la'ang 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i lam gyis thob pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ rgyun zhugs mthong lam gyis thob zin nas 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam gyis sgom spang 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pas 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas/ yang phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam khyad gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig phyir mi 'ong thob don du mi brtson pa dang brtson pa/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i bsgre'o// dbye na thod rgal ba dang rim gyis pa'i zhugs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ phyir mi 'ong ma thob par dang thob zin nas phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob don du brtson pa'i nyan thos zhugs pa/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos slob pa'i 'bras gnas/ dbye na 'bras bu thod rgal ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ mthong lam ma thob gong du dang phyir 'ong thob zin nas sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos slob pa'i 'bras gnas/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa la'ang 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i lam gyi thob pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ phyir 'ong thob zin nas 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam gyi sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pas 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas/

yang tsam khyad gnyis kyi bsgre'o// dgra bcom zhugs pa'i bsgre'o// dbye na gcig char ba dang mthar gyis ba'i zhugs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs rnam pas cig char spong bas dang*/ sgom spang 'dod nyon dgu pa spang nas dgra bcom thob don du brtson pa'i nyan thos zhugs pa/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs dgu pa spangs pa'i 'am khams gsum las 'dod chags dang bral ba'i nyan thos 'bras gnas/ dbye na cig char ba dang rim gyis pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ slob lam gyi tshe khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnams pas cig char dang rim gyis spangs pas thob pa'i dgra bcom/ yang dus sbyor dus mi sbyor gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ mthun rkyen tshang ba sogs dus kyi sbyor ba la ltos nas dang 'dod dgur rnam grol mngon du byed pa'i dgra bcom/ yang rgyun zhugs gnyis kyi re ltar thog na srid pa lan bdun pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i lha mir skye ba lan bdun blang nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas/ rigs nas rigs skye'i mtshan nyid/ sgom spangs 'dod nyon gsum mam bzhi spangs shing de'i gnyen po zag med thob la 'dod pa'i lha'am mir skye ba rigs mthun gnyis sam gsum blang nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can/ dbye na gnyis kyi mtshan nyid so sor phye ba'o// phyir 'ong bar chad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgom spang 'dod nyon bdun pa'am brgyad pa spangs shing 'dod lhar skye ba gcig blang nas mya ngan 'da' ba'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can/ phyir mi 'ong ba gsum ste/ gzugs su nyer 'gro dang gzugs med du nyer 'gro dang*/ mthong chos zhi'o// dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs khams su srid pa len pa/ dbye na bar dor 'da' ba dang*/ skyes nas 'da' ba dang*/ gong du 'pho ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid/

de gang dag srid pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gzugs kyi bar srid du dang*/ skye srid gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gzugs kyi skye srid du dang*/ gzugs kyi skye srid gnyis blang nas mya ngan las 'da' ba/ dang po la dbye na myur bar dang myur ba min par dang*/ yun ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig srid pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gzugs kyi bar srid grub ma thag dang*/ bar srid cung zad nas dang*/ bar srid nas skye srid du 'gro bar sems shing de ma thob pa na mya ngan las 'da' ba/ skyes nas 'da' ba la dbye na/ skyes ma thag dang*/ 'du byed med par dang*/ 'du byed dang bcas par 'da' ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig skye srid gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gzugs kyi skye srid du skyes ma thag dang*/ skyes nas cung zad gnas te 'bad med du lam mngon du byas nas dang*/ skyes nas tshe mjug tu 'bad pas lam mngon du byas nas mya ngan las 'da' ba/ gong du 'pho ba la dbye na/ 'og min 'gro dang srid rtser 'gro gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gong du 'pho ba gang zhig 'og min du dang srid rtser mya ngan las 'da' ba/ dang po la dbye na 'phar ba dang*/ phyed du 'phar ba dang*/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ 'og min 'gro gang zhig 'dod pa nas tshangs ris dang de nas 'og min du skyes nas dang*/ 'dod pa nas tshangs ris dang de nas gnas gtsang ma 'og ma gang rung dang de nas 'og min du skyes nas dang*/ tshangs chen ma gtogs gzugs kyi gnas gzhan thams cad du rim gyis skyes nas 'og min du mya ngan las 'da' ba/ gzugs med du nyer 'gro'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs las chags pa dang bral ba'i 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs med du skyes nas mya ngan las 'da' ba/ dbye na skyes nas dang*/ 'du byed med par dang*/ 'du byed dang bcas pas dang*/

gong du 'pho ba bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig srid pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gzugs med du skyes ma thag dang*/ skyes nas tshe dkyil du 'bad med du lam mngon du byas nas dang*/ skyes nas tshe mjug tu 'bad pas lam mngon du byas nas dang*/ gzugs med bzhir rim gyis skyes nas srid rtser mya ngan las 'da' ba/ mthong chos zhi ba'i mtshan nyid/ mthong lam thob pa'i tshe de nyid la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir mi 'ong*/ 'phar gsum gyi dbye ba dang gzugs med du nyer 'gro dang mthong chos zhi ni 'dir ma gsungs kyang gzhan du gsungs so// spel sgom gyi mtshan nyid/ sgom thun gcig la bsam gtan bzhi pa zag bcas dang zag med spel nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po dang ches che ba dang shin tu ches che ba lnga'i mtshan nyid/ sgom thun gcig la bsam gtan bzhi pa zag bcas dang zag med gsum dang*/ drug dang*/ dgu dang*/ bcu gnyis dang*/ bco lnga la spel nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ dgra bcom la dbye na/ yongs su nyams pa dang*/ bdag gsod pa dang*/ rjes su bsrung ba dang*/ gnas pa las mi bskyod pa dang*/ rab tu rtogs pa'i 'os su gyur pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can drug gi mtshan nyid/ mthong chos la bder gnas kyi snyoms 'jug las nyams par nges pa'i dgra bcom dbang rtul dang*/ de las rang gis rang mi gsod na nyams shing gsod na mi nyams pa'i dang*/ de las g.yos na nyams shing ma g.yos na mi nyams pa'i dang*/ de las mi nyams shing dbang po sbyong ba'i skal ba can min pa'i dang*/ dbang po sbyong ba'i skal ba can yin pa'i dgra bcom dbang rtul dang*/ de las ye mi nyams pa'i dgra bcom dbang rnon/ khams kyi dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gang rung gi rten can gyis phye ba'i gang zag dbye na bcu gnyis kyi so skye dang slob mi slob dgu'i mtshan nyid/ gzhung bzhin sbyar ro// 'dod gzugs na spyod pa'i byang sems kyi mtshan nyid/

dbang thob pas gzugs med du skye ba spang nas 'dod gzugs su skye ba 'dzin pa'i byang sems/ 'dod pa na spyod pa'i rang rgyal gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing du 'dod pa'i rten la rang don du byang chub mngon du byed pa'i gang zag yang na 'dod pa'i rten la rang gcig pu'i don du bdag nyid kyis byang chub rtogs pa'i gang zag 'dod pa na spyod pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i de shes pa'i/ 'dod khams su mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sangs rgyas/ spyad pas dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ byang chub chen po'i don du spyod pa spyad pas phye ba'i gang zag dbye na mos pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pas dang*/ mtshan ma dang bcas par dang*/ mtshan ma med par dang*/ mngon par 'du bya ba med par spyod pa'i byang sems lnga'i mtshan nyid/ chos nyid la spyi'i tshul gyis mos yul du byed pa'i byang sems dang*/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i dang*/ res 'ga' mi 'dod bzhin du mtshan ma dang 'dre zhing gzung 'dzin mngon gyur du 'byung ba'i dang*/ sgrims nas ci srid 'dod par mtshan 'dzin mngon gyur mi 'byung ba'i dang*/ lhun grub tu mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'byung ba'i byang sems 'phags pa/ gnyis pa thob bya mngon rtogs kyi mtshan nyid/ mngon sum mam mngon sum la phyogs pas bden bzhi yang dag par khong du chud pa'i rtogs pa/ dbye na bcu'i chos mngon rtogs kyi mtshan nyid/ bden bzhi ston pa'i gsung rab la tshogs lam gyis bsdus pa'i mos dad chen po thob pa'i rtogs pa/ don mngon rtogs kyi/ bden bzhi ston pa'i gsung rab kyi don la sbyor lam gyis bsdus pa'i bden pa la chos nges par sems pa'i bzod pa chen po thob pa'i rtogs pa/ de kho na nyid kyi mngon rtogs kyi/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam gyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa/ rjes la mngon rtogs kyi/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mthong zin sgom lam gyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa/

dkon mchog mngon rtogs kyi/ zag med kyi shes pas dkon mchog gi yon tan shes nas yid ches pa'i rtogs pa/ kun tu mi 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs kyi/ zag med kyi sdom pa thob pas rang rgyud kyi ngan song rgyu dang bcas pa zad par yid ches pa'i rtogs pa/ mthar thug mngon rtogs kyi/ zad mi skye shes pa'i mthar phyin pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa/ nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs kyi/ theg pa gsum las rang bzhin gyis dbang po rtul po myang 'das su bgrod byed kyi rtogs pa/ rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs kyi/ theg pa gsum las rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring po myang 'das su phyin byed kyi rtogs pa/ byang sems kyi mngon rtogs la shes bya dang mngon du bya ba'i mngon rtogs gnyis kyi dang po'i mtshan nyid/ nyan rang gi rigs can rnams 'dul ba'i ched du byang sems kyi yon tan yar ldan du rang la skyed nas shes bya'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bgrod byed kyi mngon rtogs/ gsum pa mngon rtogs su 'dus pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ lam la bslab pas thob pa'i phan yon/ dbye na/ tshad/ rnam/ zil/ zad/ nyon/ bsam/ so/ mngon/ mtshan/ yongs/ stobs/ mi/ dran/ bsrungs/ bsnyel/ bag thugs/ sangs/ rnam/ bcu dgu dang po tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa la brtse ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na dmigs pa'i sgo nas sems can dang*/ chos dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i tshad med gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul rdzas su yod pa'i dang*/ phung po chos tsam la btags pa'i dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can tshad med pa la brtse ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ rnam pa'i sgo nas byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms tshad med pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang phrad par dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar dang*/

chags sdang dang bral bar 'dun pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ rnam thar gyi/ rnam thar brgyad gang rung gi sgrib pa la thar pa'i ched du sgom pa'i zhi lhag gam snyoms mjug dbye na brgyad kyi gzugs can dang gzugs med la lta ba'i rnam thar gnyis kyi mtshan nyid/ sprul pa'i sgrib pa las thar ba'i ched du rnal 'byor pa bdag la gzugs can du dang gzugs can min par 'du shes pas phyi'i gzugs la sna tshogs kyi rnam par mos pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sdug pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ sdug mi sdug sprul pa la sprul snying 'dod mi 'dod kyi sgrib pa las thar ba'i ched du gzugs kun sdug par ro gcig par mos pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ gzugs kyi ro myang las thar pa'i ched du thar pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i nam mkha' dang rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug sgom pa'i dang*/ ci yang med pa'i dang*/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi snyoms 'jug sgom pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ tshor 'du 'gog pa'i sgrib pa las thar ba'i ched du sgom pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug zil gnon gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam thar gyis mos pa'i dmigs pa la dbang byed pa'i phyir zil gyis gnon pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na dbyibs kyi zil gnon nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi'i gzugs chung ngu ngan pa dang bzang po la lta ba dang*/ chen po la lta ba dang*/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi yi gzugs chung ngu dang chen po la lta ba gnyis te bzhi dang*/ kha dog gi zil gnon nang gzugs su 'du shes pa kho nas phyi'i gzugs sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi la lta ba bzhi ste brgyad do// zad par gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam thar gyis mos shing zil gnon gyis dbang du byas pa'i dmigs pa 'dod dgur phro ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/

dbye na zad par sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung dang*/ sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po ste bcu'o// nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ bdag la dmigs nas gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa 'byung ba rjes su bsrung ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na sangs rgyas dang*/ nyan thos kyi gnyis so// bsam nas shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang shes par 'dod pa de bsam nas shes pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na sngar bzhin gnyis so// so so rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ ming don nges tshig rnam pa'i rab dbye dang bcas pa gang rung thogs med du shes pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na chos dang*/ don dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ spobs pa so so yang dag pa rig bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ ming gi rnam grangs thogs med du dang*/ mtshan nyid dang dgongs pa'i don thogs med du dang*/ yul skad dang chos kyi nges tshig thogs med du dang*/ chos rab tu dbye ba na thogs med du shes pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas/ rang yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i mthu zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na rdzu 'phrul dang*/ lha'i rna ba dang*/ sems kyi rnam grangs dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba dang*/ zag zad kyi mngon shes drug gi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs shes pa'i dang*/ sgra sna tshogs thos pa'i dang*/ gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod pa du ma shes pa'i dang*/ rang gzhan gyi sngon gyi tshe rabs du ma shes pa'i dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa'i dang*/ zag pa zad pa shes pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mtshan dpe'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan nam dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa'i sku gdul bya la kun tu ston nus pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na mtshan so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cu'o// yongs su dag pa'i mtshan nyid/

gnas dang dmigs pa sogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na gnas dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ thugs dang*/ mkhyen pa yongs su dag pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ skye 'chi gnas gsum la dang*/ sprul sgyur la dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la dang*/ gzungs kyi sgo du ma la dbang bsgyur pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i stobs su gyur pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na gnas dang*/ gnas min pa dang*/ las bdag gir bya ba dang*/ bsam gtan sogs kyi kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dang*/ dbang po mchog dang mchog min dang*/ mos pa sna tshogs dang*/ khams sna tshogs dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i lam dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba dang*/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs te bcu'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu dang rgyu min dang*/ las bdag gir bya ba dang*/ bsam gtan sogs kyi ro myang nges 'byung sogs dang*/ gdul bya'i dad sogs dbang po mchog dman dang*/ gdul bya'i bsam sbyor gyi mos pa mtha' yas pa dang*/ gdul bya'i rigs kyi bye brag mtha' yas pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi lam kun dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba dang*/ zag pa zad pa chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i stobs su gyur pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ don gnyis kyi dam bca' la snyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na mngon par byang chub pa la dang*/ zag pa zad pa la dang*/ bar chad kyi chos la dang*/ nges 'byin gyi lam la mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ rang don rtogs pa rdzogs par dang*/ rang don spangs pa rdzogs par dang*/ gzhan don spang bya kun ston pa dang*/ gzhan don thar lam kun ston par zhal gyis bzhes pa la snyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/

'khor gus ma gus la chags sdang med par tshogs sdud pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ bsrung ba med pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi sgo gsum yongs su dag pas 'khor gyi nang du bag tsha ba med par gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa'i sbyor ba zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ gdul bya'i don dus las yol ba mi mnga' ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ bag chags legs par bcom pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgo gsum gyi gnas ngan len gyi g.yo ba cung zad kyang mi 'byung ba'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mtshan nyid/ rtag tu sems can gyi sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid/ rten sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba'i sgo nas nyan rang sogs las thun mong min par mtshon byed kyi yon tan/ dbye na spyod pa dang rtogs pas bsdus pa drug drug ye shes dang phrin las kyis bsdus pa gsum gsum bco brgyad do// rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa kun mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba las le'u bzhi pa'i chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid te bzhi pa'o// //'bel gtam rnam nges la bdun gyi dang po don rnam nges kyi mtshan nyid/ ngo bo sogs don drug las brtsam nas rtogs bya'i don gtan la 'bebs pa'i rnam nges gnyis pa rnam bshad rnam nges kyi mtshan nyid/ gang gis mdo sde sogs 'chad pa'i thabs ston pa'i gzhung*/ dbye na sgo bcu bzhi'i mtshan nyid la/ rnam bshad bsdu ba'i sgo ni/ mdo'i gleng gzhi dang dgongs pa dang*/ dgos don bsdus don tshig don mtshams sbyar brgal lan rnams ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// dngos po bsdus ba'i sgo ni/ bslab pa gsum sogs ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag gi sgo ni/

mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas ston pa'i gzhung ngo*/ gong nas gong du mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo ni/ snga mas phyi ma sgrub pa ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// spong ba'i sgo ni/ chos 'ga' las brtsams te gang zag 'ga' spong bar ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// yi ge yongs su sgyur ba'i sgo ni/ dngos kyi don gzhan du brjod la zhes pa'i don gzhan du sgyur ba'i gzhung ngo*// chud mi za ba'i sgo ni/ chud za mi za thabs dang dbye ba dang bcas pa ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// gang zag rnam par gzhag pa'i sgo ni/ gang zag gi dbye ba ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// rab tu dbye ba bzhag pa'i sgo ni/ mu bzhi sogs dri ba rnams kyi don brjod pa'i gzhung ngo*// tshul gyi sgo ni/ bshad bya'i tshul 'chad byed kyi tshul gyis ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// yongs shes sogs kyi sgo ni/ de kho na'i mtshan nyid sogs yongs shes sogs kyi phan yon gyi mtshan nyid kyi bar mtshan nyid bcu ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// stobs dang stobs min pa'i sgo ni/ tshig gcig ma brjod na'ang don tshan de mi go bas tshig so so kun gyi nus pa ston pa'i gzhung ngo*// bzlas te brjod pa'i sgo ni/ sngar mdor bstan pa slar yang rgyas par bstan pa'i ched du 'chad pa'i gzhung ngo*// mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo ni/ tshig so so tshig bzhi sogs dang de re re yang bzhi sogs kyis thug med du mngon par sgrub pa'i gzhung ngo*// gsum pa rab tu phye nas kun tu bstan pa rnam nges kyi mtshan nyid/ shes bya'i dngos po rnams mu bzhi sogs su phyes nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i dris lan/ dri ba rnam nges kyi/ sgra'i rnam dbye bdun dbye ba dang bcas pa'i dris lan/ bsdu ba rnam nges kyi/ 'jig rten pa nas mi slob pa'i bar gnas bcur bsdu pa'i rnam nges/ smra ba rnam nges kyi/ spyir smra tshul dang khyad par rgol phyi rgol rtsod lugs gtan la 'bebs pa'i thabs/

dbye na bdun gyi mtshan nyid/ smra ba ni ngag tu brjod pa'i tshig go /smra ba'i zhal ces pa ni/ gang du smra bar bya ba'i dpang po'o// smra ba'i gzhi ni/ gang smra bar bya ba'i gnas so// smra ba'i rgyan ni/ smra ba'i yon tan no// smra ba chad pas bcad pa ni// smra ba'i skyon no// smra ba la nges par 'byung ba ni/ skyon yon brtag na smra mi smra'i tshod shes pa'o// smra ba la gces spras bya ba'i chos ni/ gang smra ba la nges par dgos pa'i chos so// bdun pa ldem dgongs rnam nges kyi mtshan nyid/ dngos su don gzhan du brjod la zhes pa'i don gzhan du sgyur ba'i gsung rab bo// chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba las le'u lnga pa'i chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid te lnga pa'o// //rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi dgongs 'grel mchog /rgya chen shes bya yang dag 'byed mdzad cing*// rnam pa kun mkhyen thun mong min pa'i rgyu// dam chos mngon pa kun las btus pa yi// bsdus don mtshan nyid rab tu gsal ba 'di// blo ldan don gnyer kun la phan phyir bsdebs// dge bas 'gro kun rtag tu 'dir zhugs pas// kun mkhyen ye shes go 'phang myur thob shog /tshul 'di ni chos rje dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ chos mngon pa'i sde snod la blo'i snang ba thob pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal e wam̐ chos 'byung gi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'o// 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /shu bhaṃ// //oṃ swa sti/ chos rab rnam 'byed rigs pa'i nyi 'od kyis// legs phyes mngon pa'i sde snod pad dkar tshal// snying po'i gzhung kun btus pa'i sbrang rtsi'i bcud// mkhas mang bung bas bsnyen pa'i tshal du grub// gang gi zab don 'byed byed legs bshad phul// 'jam mgon rigs kyi thig le'i gsung gi spar// kun mkhyen bla ma'i phrin las kyis snang bas// blo ldan spobs pa'i lang tsho dar gyur cig
